SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. D. 62234
S.I., Special Branch
REPORT
Date. Dec. 23, 1936.
Subject: Industrial Bank of China - Bankruptcy Proceedings.
Made by D.S.I. Coyne Forwarded by
Under the auspices of the Shanghai Special
District Court, some 240 creditors of the Industrial Bank
of China, 300 Nanking Road (which closed down on October
11, 1934) held a meeting in the Nanking Club, 343 Nanking
Road, between 2.30 p.m. and 3.40 p.m. December 17. Judge
Kiang Kung-liang (江公亮) presided, and a court clerk
made a report to the following effect :-
"Although the Industrial Bank of China is in
debt to the amount of $850,000, it has a credit of $800,000.
The difference seems to be not very much, but out of $800,000
it has, however, only succeeded in collecting $1,500 owing
to the fact that the majority of the debtors cannot be
located."
The liquidator of the firm named Hsu Yung-tao
(徐永祚), chartered accountant, then reported on behalf of
Loh Sin-hou that efforts would be made to refund to the
creditors 10% of their deposits within 60 days. The attendance
agreed to this announcement, and decided to request Judge
Kiang to submit this decision to the President of the Court
for approval.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案号 D. 62234
特别科（S.I., Special Branch）
报告
日期：1936年12月23日。
主题：中国实业银行 - 破产程序。
由特别科督察（D.S.I.）科因（Coyne）呈报，转呈者

在上海特区法院的主持下，中国实业银行（位于南京路300号，该行于1934年10月11日停业）的约240名债权人于12月17日下午2时30分至3时40分之间，在南京路343号的南京俱乐部举行会议。江公亮法官担任主席，一名法院书记员作了如下报告：
“虽然中国实业银行负债达85万元，但其拥有债权80万元。差额似乎不大，然而在这80万元债权中，由于大多数债务人下落不明，仅成功收回1,500元。”
随后，该行的清算人、注册会计师徐永祚代表罗嗣侯报告称，将努力在60天内向债权人退还其存款的10%。与会人员同意此项公告，并决定请求江法官将此决定提交法院院长批准。
我，科因

were passed :-

Liang advising him to restore General Chiang Kai Shek
to Nanking.

at the Dah Kwei Lou Restaurant (大瑰樓), Foochow Road.
3) That any school may join the Association.

Subject (in full) The Industrial Bank of China, No. 172 Nanking Road, and the affairs of the Metropolitan Sporting Club.

Made by D.S.I. E.M. Golder Forwarded by [签名]

（左侧手写批注：See Global Reg file c 1915）

The Industrial Bank of China was, according to reports, originally opened by General Wu Pei Fu and a number of the leaders under him in about the year 1924. Very little information is on hand regarding the subsequent activities of the bank until 1930, when, it has been learned, its affairs were in such bad shape that Loh Sih Er, C.K. Chen, Witson Shan, and L.W. Woo were able to buy over the controlling interest for a mere song. From that time on the bank has never enjoyed the confidence of banking circles, largely owing to the fact that Loh Sih Er and his associates were known to be persons of doubtful character. At the time the Industrial Bank of China closed its doors to the public Loh Sih Er was Managing Director and Ching Pao Yuen, an appointee of his, was Manager. The remainder of the people mentioned on the board of directors, with the possible exception of L. W. Woo, are the usual type of influential Chinese whose names are sought by banks and big businesses to gain the confidence of the public.

Now Loh Sih Er besides being on the board of directors of the Industrial Bank of China is managing proprietor of the Hotel Plaza and a number of amusement resorts in various parts of the Settlement, French Concession and Chinese Territory. His connection with the Hotel Plaza has a certain significance as this report will show.

At about the end of May this year Loh Sih Er (陸錫侯), approached an old acquaintance of his an American named G. C. Friedgen, Far Eastern Representative of the United Kingdom Tobacco Company, The Ward Building No. 680 Szechuen Road, and asked him to form an association for the promotion of trotting racing locally. Friedgen conferred with a few fellow

由特别科督察 E.M. Golder 呈报，转呈者 [签名]

（左侧手写批注：见全球登记档案 c 1915）

据报告，中国实业银行最初是由吴佩孚将军及其麾下多名头目于1924年左右开设的。关于该银行随后的活动，手头资料甚少，直到1930年，据悉其经营状况恶化至极点，致使罗嗣侯、陈克昌（C.K. Chen）、山维森（Witson Shan）和伍联德（L.W. Woo）得以以极低的价格收购了控股权。从那时起，该银行从未获得银行界的信任，这很大程度上是因为罗嗣侯及其同伙被公认为品行可疑之人。在中国实业银行对公众关闭大门时，罗嗣侯任总经理，其任命的经理为郑宝元（Ching Pao Yuen）。董事会名单上提到的其余人员，除了伍联德可能例外，都是那种银行和大企业为了赢得公众信任而寻求其挂名的典型有影响力的中国人。

如今，罗嗣侯除了担任中国实业银行董事外，还是华懋公寓酒店（Hotel Plaza）的管理业主，并在公共租界、法租界及华界多处拥有娱乐产业。他与华懋公寓酒店的关系具有一定的意义，本报告将予以说明。

今年5月底左右，罗嗣侯（陸錫侯）接触了他的一位老相识、美国人 G. C. Friedgen，此人是英国烟草公司远东代表，办事处位于四川路680号华德大楼。罗嗣侯请他组建一个协会，以在当地推广赛马运动。Friedgen 与几位同事进行了商议

From information obtained from one of his close
followers, Loh Sih Hou (S.H. Loh) has invested about
$400,000 in the Trotting Club and there is little doubt
that this money or a major portion of it has been drawn
from the Industrial Bank of China of which Loh is the
sole proprietor. The syndicate called Kwan Yi Group
which was formed in 1931 by Loh and others to take over the

manager Ching Pao Yuen was simply a figure head drawing

据从其一名亲信处获得的情报，陆锡侯（S.H. Loh）在跑马总会投资了约40万美元，毫无疑问，这笔钱或其中大部分是从中国实业银行提取的，而陆氏是该银行的唯一所有者。由陆氏及其他人为从原业主手中接管该银行而于1931年组成的名为“广义集团”（Kwan Yi Group）的辛迪加已解散。经理秦抱元（Ching Pao Yuen）仅仅是一个挂名人物，月薪280美元。据盛传的谣言称，陆氏指示其消失，以便将银行倒闭的责任推卸给他。

从其活动来看，陆锡侯是一个除非在企业中被赋予全权，否则不会进行任何投资的人。当他创办一家公司时，他总是持有大多数股份，而在业务兴隆时，他会排挤其他股东。
                                            华懋饭店
陆氏是跑马总会、中国实业银行、修女院路（Rue des Soeurs）的大先施凯（Ta Sien Sih Kai，音译）以及市内“小世界”游乐场的拥有者。

除最后提到的这家机构外，这些企业均无利可图。

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE OPIUM SUPPRESSION MOVEMENT

The various local Tangpus and military
and government organs the other day held a preparatory
meeting at the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's
Headquarters to discuss measures for the starting of a
propaganda movement for the suppression of opium and
narcotics. The meeting was attended by Mr. Tan Lien
Tseng (戴立珍) representing the Bureau of Public Safety,
Mr. Tsai Pu Bah (蔡步白) representing the Shanghai
Opium Suppression Committee, Mr. Tung Mou Kuh (董慕葛)
representing the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang
Headquarters and Mr. Loh Chin Shih (陸京士) representing
the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters.
The following decisions were reached:
(1) That the opium suppression propaganda
be started from November 10 and terminate on November 20.
(2) That the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison
Commissioner's Headquarters issue a notification warning
opium and narcotic addicts to undergo a voluntary cure
of their habit.
(3) That the Shanghai Opium Suppression
Committee and the Bureau of Public Safety prepare handbills,
slogans and cartoons and other propaganda literature for
this movement.
(4) That the Bureau of Public Safety
undertake the posting and distribution of this literature.
(5) That the Shanghai District Kuomintang
Headquarters instruct all public amusement resorts to
broadcast such propaganda.
(6) That the Bureau of Public Safety
undertake the dissemination of propaganda through newspapers.
(7) That the Shanghai Opium Suppression
Committee and the Bureau of Public Safety bear the expenses
for the printing of this literature.

The Great Daily News and other local newspapers :-

THE AFFAIRS OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

In connection with the failure of the
Industrial Bank of China of which Loh Sih Hou (陸錫侯)
was the proprietor, the creditors of the bank recently
filed a petition with the Shanghai First Special
District Court.
At 2 p.m. yesterday, a meeting of the
creditors of the Industrial Bank of China was held at
the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, when a clash took
place between the creditors and the debtors, resulting
in the immediate break up of the meeting.

《民报》及当地其他报纸：-

禁烟运动

日前，各地方塘铺（Tangpus，音译，指基层行政或警务单位）及军政机关在淞沪警备司令部总部举行预备会议，讨论启动禁止鸦片和麻醉品宣传运动的措施。出席会议的有代表公安局的戴立珍（Tan Lien Tseng）先生、代表上海禁烟委员会的蔡步白（Tsai Pu Bah）先生、代表国民党上海特别区党部的董慕葛（Tung Mou Kuh）先生以及代表淞沪警备司令部的陆京士（Loh Chin Shih）先生。
达成以下决定：
(1) 禁烟宣传自11月10日开始，至11月20日结束。
(2) 由淞沪警备司令部发布通告，警告鸦片和麻醉品成瘾者自愿戒除毒瘾。
(3) 由上海禁烟委员会和公安局准备传单、标语、漫画及其他宣传材料以供此次运动使用。
(4) 由公安局负责张贴和分发这些宣传材料。
(5) 由国民党上海特别区党部指示所有公共娱乐场所广播此类宣传内容。
(6) 由公安局负责通过报纸进行宣传 dissemination。
(7) 印刷这些宣传材料的费用由上海禁烟委员会和公安局承担。

《大日报》及当地其他报纸：-

中国实业银行事件

关于由陆锡侯（Loh Sih Hou）所有的中国实业银行倒闭一事，该银行债权人近日向上海第一特区地方法院提交诉状。

THE FAILURE OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

Following the failure of the Industrial Bank
of China, Loh Sih Hou, Chairman of the Board of Directors
of the bank, Loh Maung Shiang, Manager, and Loh Tsoo Dong
were charged by the S.M.C. in the First Special District
Court with misappropriation of deposits and breach of
confidence and were sentenced to a term of six months
imprisonment each.

Loh Sih Hou and the others appealed to the
Second Branch Kiangsu High Court. After a number of
hearings, the High Court yesterday morning handed down
a decision quashing the judgment of the District Court.

It is reported that Paul P.Y. Ru, Assistant
Municipal Advocate, contemplates filing an appeal with the
Supreme Court.

INDUSTRIAL BANK
MEN ACQUITTED

Settlement Police May

Supreme Court

Lu Shih-hou, former director of
the defunct China Industrial Bank,
who figured prominently last year
in many court proceedings when
the closing of his institution affect-
ed the International Trotting
Club, and his two assistants, Lu
Men-hsiang and Lu Tsu-tung, were

priation and fraud yesterday by

The high court decision was a
result of the filing of an appeal
against the six months' prison term
meted out to each of them by the
First Special District Court, but

Police are planning to appeal
against the new ruling in the
Supreme Court at Nanking. Cre-
ditors of the defunct bank have
organized an association and it
was reported last year that the
bank's bad debts amounted to a
sum running into six figures.

THE SHANGHAI SUNDAY TIMES, OCTOBER 13, 1935

Heavy Losses
In Trotting
Plan Fiasco

$400,000 Said Lost By
Parties Interested
In The Venture

CANCELLED AGREEMENT
ENDS ENTERPRISE

More Than Hundred Horses
Still At Old C.J.C.
Headquarters

Three hundred thousand dollars have been lost by the Metropolitan Sporting Association and about $100,000 by the Far Eastern Recreation Grounds, Ltd. as a result of their failure to obtain official permission to start trotting at the Chinese Jockey Club in Hsinyangkong, which is within the jurisdiction of the Greater Shanghai City Government. The recent advertised cancellation of the agreement between the two bodies for the lease of the club has doomed the fate of the enterprise, an official told “The Shanghai Sunday Times” yesterday.

More than 100 horses bought by the former organization are said to be still cared for at the C. J. C. old headquarters. These horses, which were brought from Australia at the average price of $1,000 per head, originally numbered more than 150 but have now been reduced to less than 100, according to an official of the Far Eastern Recreation Grounds, Ltd. He said that, pending the final disposal of the animals, his company was willing to allow them to stay at the club.

Mayor Wu Te-chen, of Greater Shanghai, is said to have been conciliatory towards the enterprise, but he insisted that no horse races should be held in the evening, which is contrary to the original plan of the organizers of the International Trotting Club and which rendered it impossible to go on with the business.

Loh's Share

The Metropolitan Sporting Association, which proposed to run the club, was an American organization in name only, for, it is said, the Americans put but $5,000 into the business. The man who suffered the most was Mr. S. H. Loh, former managing director of the closed Industrial Bank of China, who contributed the lion’s share of the capital, and who is still facing trial in the First Special District Court. Through his mediation the agreement of the lease of the Chinese Jockey Club by the Far Eastern Recreation Grounds, Ltd. to the American organization was recently cancelled.

The former organisation at first desired to claim rental which was never paid. A legal battle was fought between the two contracting parties in the U. S. Court for China, but, in view of the fact that the court could not follow any precedent in giving a decision, the parties were ordered to settle the question outside the court, and hence the cancellation agreement which caused the Chinese organization to lose $100,000. This organization is said to have originally planned to start horse racing

大都会体育协会（Metropolitan Sporting Association）损失了30万美元，远东游乐场有限公司（Far Eastern Recreation Grounds, Ltd.）损失了约10万美元，原因是他们未能获得官方许可，在位于大上海市政府管辖范围内的新洋港（Hsinyangkong）中国赛马会（Chinese Jockey Club）开始举办轻驾车赛马。一位官员昨日告诉《上海星期时报》，最近双方公告取消关于租赁该俱乐部的协议，注定了该企业的命运。

据称，前一家组织购买的100多匹马目前仍在中国赛马会旧总部得到照料。远东游乐场有限公司的一位官员表示，这些马是从澳大利亚运来的，平均每匹价格为1,000美元，最初数量超过150匹，但现在已减少到不足100匹。他说，在这些动物得到最终处置之前，他的公司愿意让它们留在俱乐部。

据说大上海市长吴铁城对该企业持调和态度，但他坚持不得在晚间举行赛马，这与国际轻驾车赛马俱乐部组织者的原计划相悖，使得业务无法继续开展。

陆氏的股份

提议经营该俱乐部的大都会体育协会仅在名义上是美国组织，据说美国人仅向该企业投入了5,000美元。遭受损失最大的是已关闭的中国工业银行前总经理陆锡侯先生（Mr. S. H. Loh），他提供了大部分资本，并且仍在第一特区地方法院受审。经过他的调解，远东游乐场有限公司与美国组织之间关于租赁中国赛马会的协议最近被取消。

前者组织起初希望索赔从未支付的租金。缔约双方在美国在华法院进行了法律斗争，但是，鉴于法院在作出判决时无法遵循任何先例，双方被命令在庭外解决此问题，因此达成了取消协议，导致中方组织损失10万美元。据说该组织原计划开始举办赛马

October 15, 1938.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers :-
BUREAU OF PUBLIC SAFETY TO ADOPT WINTER PRECAUTIONARY
MEASURES

As the winter season is approaching, the
Bureau of Public Safety is planning to adopt winter
precautionary measures as soon as the 6th National
Athletic Meeting terminates. The Bureau will advise
shops and citizens to instal police alarms and other
anti-robbery equipments and will also detail more
policemen to various wharves both day and night.
Yesterday afternoon the Officer-in-Charge
of the Jin Loh Poo (十六鋪) Branch of the Bureau of
Public Safety held a meeting at which certain winter
precautionary measures to be adopted in Nantao were
decided on.

China Times and other local newspapers:
THE CHINA INDUSTRIAL BANK

On the afternoon of October 14, the First
Special District Court resumed the trial of the case
of the closing of the China Industrial Bank. Loh Tsu
Dong (陸祖全), Manager of the Quinsan Branch of the
defunct Ningpo Industrial Bank, who had been charged
by the S.M.P. with fraud for having conspired with
Loh Sih Hou (陸錫侯), Chairman of the Board of
Directors of the China Industrial Bank, put in an
appearance in company with his defending lawyer.
Loh Sih Fou, Loh Mong Shiang (陸夢翔) and Sung Shi
Zung (宋士宗), Manager and Sub-Manager of the China
Industrial Bank, accompanied by their respective
lawyers, were also present.
After giving an explanation for the charge
brought against Loh Tsu Dong, the Municipal Advocate
requested the Court to question Tsi Zung Tsang (戚成章),
an employee of Brandt & Rodgers, who was present,
regarding the transfer of the title deed of Wong Sz
(王氏)(wife of Loh Sih Hou), who lent it to the China
Industrial Bank, which, in turn, mortgaged it to the
Ningpo Commercial Bank.
The Court questioned Tsi concerning the matter.
The lawyer defending the accused Loh Sih Hou
then gave the following explanation concerning the
mortgage of the title deed:- "As the China Industrial
Bank needed money, Loh Sih Hou borrowed the title
deed from his wife. Loh did not wish the bank to
put its name in borrowing money, so he instructed his
wife to mortgage the title deed for $70,000 with the
Business Department of the bank and then to deposit
this sum in the Savings Department of the bank. The
bank then put the deed in the Ningpo Commercial Bank
as a security to obtain banknotes. As Loh did not
wish the Ta Tsai World Amusement Resort (大千世界) and
other concerns that he is involved in to be indebted
to the bank, he drew out the $70,000 that his wife
had deposited it in the Savings Department and paid
his debts with the money".

公安局将采取冬季预防措施

随着冬季临近，
公安局计划在第六届全国运动会结束后尽快采取冬季

《时事新报》及其他本地报纸：
中国工业银行

10月14日下午，第一特区地方法院重新审理中国工业银行关闭案。已倒闭的宁波工业银行昆山支行经理陆祖全（Loh Tsu Dong / 陸祖全），此前因被控与中国工业银行董事会主席陆锡侯（Loh Sih Hou / 陸錫侯）共谋欺诈而受到工部局警务处指控，与其辩护律师一同出庭。中国工业银行经理陆梦翔（Loh Mong Shiang / 陸夢翔）和副经理宋士宗（Sung Shi Zung / 宋士宗）也在各自律师的陪同下出席。
公诉人就针对陆祖全的指控作出解释后，请求法院询问在场的百达洋行（Brandt & Rodgers）职员戚成章（Tsi Zung Tsang / 戚成章），关于王师氏（Wong Sz / 王氏）（陆锡侯之妻）房地契转让一事，该房地契借给中国工业银行，后者又将其抵押给宁波商业银行。
法院就此事项询问了戚成章。
随后，被告陆锡侯的辩护律师就房地契抵押一事作出如下解释：“由于中国工业银行需要资金，陆锡侯向其妻子借用房地契。陆不希望银行以自身名义借款，因此指示其妻子将房地契向银行业务部抵押借款70,000元，然后将这笔款项存入银行储蓄部。随后银行将该契据作为担保品存入宁波商业银行以获取钞票。由于陆不希望其涉足的大千世界（Ta Tsai World Amusement Resort）及其他企业欠银行债务，他取出了其妻子存入储蓄部的70,000元，并用这笔钱偿还了他的债务”。

October 15, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

Questioned by the Court, accused Loh Tsu Dong
stated:- "On October 1, 1934, a man named Wu (吴) of
the China Industrial Bank requested the cashing of three
cash orders of the bank. I then paid $10,000 for two
of the three cash orders from the Quinsan Branch of the
Ningpo Industrial Bank. Wu cashed the third order
for $5,000 from the Soochow Branch of the Ningpo
Industrial Bank. In the meantime, Wu made a verbal
declaration that the rent of the houses belonging to
the China Industrial Bank would be the security for the
three cash orders. The China Industrial Bank closed
down before the cash orders were due for payment.
Wu Tse Hau (吴则豪), General Manager of the Ningpo
Industrial Bank, gave to me the cash order of the China
Industrial Bank, received by the Soochow Branch of the
Ningpo Industrial Bank and instructed me to file a
charge against Loh Sih Hou and others".
The Court instructed Loh Tsu Dong to tell the
truth as, according to a report made by the auditors
appointed by the Court, the China Industrial Bank had
already paid a cash order for $5,000. Loh Mong Shiang
was then questioned about the issuing of the three cash
orders.
As it was then 5 o'clock, the Chief of the
Criminal Division remanded the case to the afternoon
of Wednesday (? October 16). Loh Tsu Dong was allowed
out on bail of $2,000 cash or shop security.

Sin Wen Pao (Editorial):

THE INCIDENT OF THE WEST BANNER.

The incident of the West Banner has broken out
and the Central Government has decided to delegate Ho Jin
Wu to bring about a settlement to the dispute.
It is not easy to maintain peace on the border
especially at the present moment. According to
information received, the question of the dispute does
not solely rest with the two opposing parties of the
Mongolian princes for there are certain others matters
of local importance that are involved in the dispute.
If the dispute cannot be solved at an early date, it
is to be feared that another trouble may arise.
Not only does the incident of the West Banner
effect the peace of the border, but it is also connected
with foreign aggression. Others have been keeping a
watch on the situation for a long time. Even in times
of peace, it is anxious that others may have a pretext
to intrude. Furthermore, there are more parties that
are desirous of having a hand in the Mongolian affairs.
As the present situation is exceedingly dangerous,
the government must exert its utmost to effect an early
settlement of the incident of the West Banner.

CANTON POST OFFICE NOT TO ACCEPT SHANGHAI BANKNOTES

the Post Office not to accept Shanghai banknotes.

1935年10月15日。下午译文。

经法院讯问，被告陆祖全陈述：“1934年10月1日，中国工业银行一名姓吴（Wu）的人要求兑现该银行的三张现金凭单。随后我从宁波工业银行昆山支行支付了两张现金凭单，共计10,000元。吴从宁波工业银行苏州支行兑现了第三张5,000元的凭单。其间，吴口头声明，中国工业银行所属房屋的租金将作为这三张现金凭单的担保。中国工业银行在现金凭单到期付款前关闭。宁波工业银行总经理吴则豪（Wu Tse Hau）将宁波工业银行苏州支行收到的中国工业银行现金凭单交给我，并指示我对陆锡侯等人提起诉讼”。
法院指示陆祖全如实陈述，因为根据法院指定的审计员所作的报告，中国工业银行已经支付了一张5,000元的现金凭单。随后就三张现金凭单的签发事宜对陆梦翔进行了讯问。
由于当时已是5点钟，刑事科科长将案件延期至周三（？10月16日）下午审理。陆祖全获准以2,000元现金或店铺担保保释外出。

《新闻报》（社论）：

西旗事件。

西旗事件爆发，中央政府已决定委派何敬武（Ho Jin Wu）促成争端解决。
维持边境和平并非易事，尤其是在当前时刻。据收到的消息，争端问题不仅仅在于蒙古王公的两个对立方面，还涉及某些具有地方重要性的其他事项。如果争端不能早日解决，恐怕会引发另一场麻烦。
西旗事件不仅影响边境和平，还与外国侵略有关。其他人长期以来一直在关注局势。即使在和平时期，也担心他人可能找到借口进行干涉。此外，还有更多方面渴望插手蒙古事务。鉴于当前局势极其危险，政府必须竭尽全力尽早解决西旗事件。

广州邮局拒收上海钞票

遵照政治委员会的命令，广东省政府已指示邮局拒收上海钞票。

Sin Wan Fao publishes the following article written by
Wei Dao (衛道) :-

THE MOLESTING OF PEDESTRIANS BY FOREIGN GIRLS
ON NORTH SZECHUEN ROAD

"Gentleman, Do you want foreign girls?
There are also Russian girls."
When you walk on the sidewalks along North
Szechuen Road, you will hear these words in a low tone.
Of course they are the "open air" interpreters on that
mysterious street, who solicit patrons for those girls
who earn their living by selling their bodies. Usually
Chinese loafers undertake this kind of work. However,
their work is now performed by the Russian girls themselves.
These Russian girls stand on the sidewalks of the road
and molest pedestrians. The bars established by
Russians along North Szechuen Road and Jukong Road (虬江路)
are really places of assignation. The Russian girls
usually molest pedestrians and entice them into these
bars. It is very difficult to argue with these girls
owing to the language difficulty.
The place where these bars are established
is under the jurisdiction of the 1st Police Station of the
5th District of the Bureau of Public Safety. The officers
of this station have been so busy attending to their
duties that they have not had time to suppress this practice.
It is to be hoped that the authorities concerned will put
a stop to this practice immediately.

The China Industrial Bank closed down on
October 11, 1934, Loh Sih Hou (陸錫侯), Chairman of

After several hearings, the Judicial Authorities

The civil part of the case has now been almost

The S.M.P. further charged Loh Sih Hou and

for his presence in Court was served but Loh Tsu Dong
failed to put in an appearance yesterday.
After interrogating Loh Sih Hou, Loh Mong
Shiang and Sung Shi Zung, the Judge ordered Paul Lu, the
Municipal Advocate of the Council to make a report on the

《新闻报》刊登魏道（衛道）撰写的以下文章：-

北四川路洋女骚扰行人案

“先生，要外国姑娘吗？
还有俄国姑娘。”
当你走在北四川路的人行道上时，你会听到低声说出的这些话。
当然，这些人是那条神秘街道上的“露天”拉客者，为那些靠出卖肉体谋生的女孩招揽顾客。通常这类工作由中国闲散人员承担。然而，现在这项工作由俄国女孩自己来做。
这些俄国女孩站在路边人行道上骚扰行人。俄国人沿北四川路和虬江路（Jukong Road）开设的酒吧实际上是幽会场所。俄国女孩通常骚扰行人并引诱他们进入这些酒吧。由于语言障碍，很难与这些女孩理论。
这些酒吧所在地属于公安局第五区第一警察分局管辖。该分局警员因忙于公务，无暇取缔此种行为。希望有关当局立即制止这种行为。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：-

中国实业银行

中国实业银行于1934年10月11日停业，该行董事会主席陆锡侯（Loh Sih Hou）、经理陆梦翔（Loh Mong Shiang）及副经理宋士宗（Sung Shi Zung）被工部局警务处以挪用公款、欺诈及违背信任罪起诉。同时，该银行债权人也向第一特区地方法院提出上诉。
经过数次聆讯，司法当局决定先进行银行清算，刑事部分暂时中止。民事部分现已基本解决。昨日，法院恢复审理案件刑事部分，陆锡侯、陆梦翔和宋士宗到庭。
工部局警务处进一步指控陆锡侯和陆梦翔与已倒闭的宁波实业银行昆山支行经理陆祖同（Loh Tsu Dong）共谋，挪用15,000美元。已向陆祖同送达出庭传票，但他昨日未出庭。
在讯问陆锡侯、陆梦翔和宋士宗后，法官命令市议会市政检察官保罗·卢（Paul Lu）就

挪用15,000美元一事提交报告。负责此案的洋籍侦探随后陈述，经查阅审计师对银行账户的审计报告发现，该银行发出了三张各为5,000美元的现金支付令，应于1934年10月12日付款。这笔钱（共计15,000美元）支付给了陆祖同。此付款行为非法（银行于10月11日关闭）。此举损害了银行债权人的利益。侦探同时向法官提交了相关现金支付令及有关账簿以供调查。

October 6, 1935. Morning Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

SUN FO'S VIEWS ON ITALIAN-ABYSSINIAN WAR.

Sun Fo, President of the Legislative Yuan,
arrived in Shanghai from Nanking on the morning of
October 5.
Upon learing of his arrival in this locality,
several local press representatives called at his residence in
Columbia Road. During an interview Sun Fo expressed
the following views:-
1) I believe that the war between Italy and
Abyssinia will not be converted into a world war aslong
as Britain and France do not place forcibly restrictions
upon Italy.
2) I approve of the proposed plan of Marshal
Yen Hsi Shan for the abolition of private ownership of
land. His plan will be brought up for discussion by the
Central Political Council, and is agreeable to the
doctrines of the Kuomintang.
3) With the exception of Hu Han Ming, who is
now on his journey from Europe to America, nearly all the
members of the Central Executive Committee and the
Central Supervisory Committee of the Kuomintang in the
South-West will participate in the forthcoming sixth
plenary congress to be held in Nanking next month.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

ARRIVAL OF PRESIDENT LIN SEN.

President Lin Sen will arrive in Shanghai
from Nanking this morning. He will conduct the ceremony
for the holding of the national athletic meeting in the
Civil Centre.

China Times and other local newspapers:

LOH SIH HOU'S LIQUIDATION.

On September 30, 1935 the First Shanghai
Special District granted the petition submitted by the
counsel of Loh Sih Hou, 陸錫侯 Managing-Director of the
Industrial Bank of China, announcing his liquidation.
All creditors are warned to register their claims with
the Court auditor on or before October 24, and a meeting
of creditors will be held at 1 p.m. October 28 in the
Wuchow Guild, at the corner of Kweichow and Peking Roads.

孙科关于意阿战争的观点。

立法院院长孙科于10月5日上午从南京抵达上海。
得知其抵达本地后，几位本地新闻界代表前往其哥伦比亚路寓所拜访。在一次采访中，孙科表达了以下观点：-
1) 我认为，只要英国和法国不强行限制意大利，意大利与阿比西尼亚之间的战争就不会演变为世界大战。
2) 我赞成阎锡山元帅提出的废除土地私有制计划。他的计划将提交中央政治委员会讨论，且符合国民党教义。
3) 除胡汉民目前正从欧洲前往美国途中外，西南地区的国民党中央执行委员会和中央监察委员会几乎所有成员都将参加下月在南京举行的第六届中央全会。

September 17, 1935. Morning Translation.

Sze Fa Jih Pao (司法日報) (Judicial Daily News) and other local newspapers:

THE FAILURE OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

In connection with the failure of the Industrial Bank of China, the First Shanghai Special District Court summoned a meeting of creditors of the bank at 1 p.m. yesterday at the Huchow Club (湖社), Kweichow Road.
Auditors Zee Yung Tso (徐永祚) and Li Ting (李鼎), lawyer Zien Sz Sung (錢樹声), Li Chia Zai (李家載), Clerk of the First Special District Court, and Ying Zeu Kwang (殷春光), Ghui Sz Chi (瞿世基) and other representatives of the creditors, in all 859 persons, were present. Debtor Loh Meng Shiang (陸夢湘) and lawyer Loh Zai Tseng (陸在曾) representing Loh Sih Hou (陸錫侯) also attended.
Zee Yung Tso, Li Ting, Zien Sz Sung and Li Chia Zai formed the presidium.
Auditor Li Ting made the following report:-
"The number of creditors present is less than three-fourths of the registered number. According to Section 3 of Article 58 of the Provisional Regulations governing liquidations, if no decision is reached regarding the measures for a peaceful settlement within two months of the date of the first meeting of creditors, the Court could, at the request of the creditors or on its own authority, declare the bankruptcy of the debtors. The new Bankruptcy Law will come into force on October 1, 1935. Therefore, the creditors must either accept or turn down within this month the measures drawn up by the debtors for a peaceful settlement of the dispute. As the creditors present are insufficient for a quorum, a decision should be made as to whether another meeting of creditors should be called this month".
The creditors present unanimously rejected the measures for a peaceful settlement because, although it is suggested in these measures that 40 per cent of the claims would be paid, in reality, only 20 per cent was certain. The creditors requested the Court to declare the bankruptcy of the debtors.
The presidium accepted the views of the creditors and said that they would be forwarded to the Court for instructions.
Clerk Li of the Court said that if the debtors revised within this month the measures for a peaceful settlement of the dispute and submit them again to the Court, the Court may still accept the measures and forward them to the creditors for discussion at another meeting.

《司法日报》（Sze Fa Jih Pao）及其他本地报纸：-

中国实业银行倒闭案

关于中国实业银行倒闭一事，上海第一特区地方法院于昨日下午1时在贵州路湖州会馆（湖社）召集该银行债权人会议。
审计师徐永祚（Zee Yung Tso）和李鼎（Li Ting）、律师钱树声（Zien Sz Sung）、李家载（Li Chia Zai）、第一特区地方法院书记员，以及殷春光（Ying Zeu Kwang）、瞿世基（Ghui Sz Chi）等债权人代表，共计859人出席。债务人陆梦湘（Loh Meng Shiang）及代表陆锡侯（Loh Sih Hou）的律师陆在曾（Loh Zai Tseng）也出席了会议。
徐永祚、李鼎、钱树声和李家载组成主席团。
审计师李鼎作如下报告：-
“出席的债权人人数少于登记人数的四分之三。根据《清算暂行条例》第五十八条第三款规定，如果在第一次债权人会议之日起两个月内未能就和解措施达成决议，法院可根据债权人请求或依职权宣告债务人破产。新《破产法》将于1935年10月1日生效。因此，债权人必须在本月内接受或拒绝债务人为和平解决纠纷而制定的措施。由于出席债权人不足法定人数，应决定是否在本月再次召开债权人会议”。
出席的债权人一致拒绝和解措施，因为虽然这些措施建议支付40%的债权，但实际上只有20%是有把握的。债权人请求法院宣告债务人破产。
主席团接受债权人的意见，并表示将呈报法院请示。
法院李书记员表示，如果债务人在本月内修订和平解决纠纷的措施并再次提交法院，法院仍可能接受这些措施，并将其转交债权人在另一次会议上讨论。

August 27, 1935. Morning Translation.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE ACTION AGAINST A CHINESE JUDGE.

At 2 p.m. yesterday the action filed by Loh Sih Hou against Judge Yu Zang Ts(余長資) of the Civil Division of the Shanghai First Special District Court for altering documents in connection with the liquidation of the Industrial Bank of China came up before Judge Wu Tseh Han(吳則韓) for hearing.
Both Loh Sih Hou and Judge Yu Zang Ts did not appear. Loh, upon receipt of a Court summons, instructed his lawyer to request the Court to transfer to another Court. Loh's lawyer informed the Court that Loh was not in Shanghai at present.
Judge Wu then adjourned the case until a decision has been rendered by the superior Court regarding the request made by Loh Sih Hou for the transfer of the case to another Court for trial.

Sin Wan Pao (Evening Edition) of August 26 :-

$20,000,000 LOAN FOR RELIEF OF CHINESE COAL INDUSTRY.

Sometime ago the National Coal Mine Onwers Association appealed to the Ministry of Industry to issue debentures for the relief of the coal industry.
As there would be great difficulty in issuing debentures, the Ministry of Industry arranged with McBain Imports, Ld., a local British concern, for a loan of $20,000,000 with interest from 6% to 8%. All the conditions of the loan have been agreed to and a formal contract for repayment after 30 years has been signed. It was also stipulated that should any coal mine desire loans in future, it must first secure permission from the Ministry of Industry and then make arrangements with McBain Imports, Ld.

Sin Wan Pao (Evening Edition) of August 26 :-

RICSHA COOLIES REQUEST REORGANIZATION OF MUTUAL AID ASSOCIATION

At 10 a.m. yesterday Tsu Zuh Chong(朱日昌), Tseu Han Ching(周漢卿), Hsia Wei Ziang(夏維祥) and Tsu Feng Ziang(朱鳳翔), representatives of the Special District Ricsha Coolies Association, submitted an appeal to Mr. Yao Tseng Moo, Chinese Deputy Commissioner of the Shanghai Municipal Police, requesting that the Ricsha Pullers' Mutual Aid Association be instructed to hand over its affairs for re-organization.
Meanwhile the Ricsha Coolies Association also detailed Chong Sung Vung(龔公文) and Zee Tso Ling(徐竹林) to make a similar appeal to the Chinese Ratepayers Association. The callers were received by Dao Loh Jing(陶樂靜), Secretary of the Ratepayers Association, who promised that instructions would be sought regarding their request.

August 21, 1935. Morning Translation.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

LOH SIH HOU FILES ACTION AGAINST CHINESE JUDGE.

Subsequent to the failure of the Industrial Bank
of China in October last year, the Shanghai Municipal Police
brought charges of fraud and embezzlement against Loh Sih
Hou, Chairman of the Board of Directors of the bank. After
several hearings the Court ordered a suspension of the
prosecution, while Loh Sih Hou, as the statutory agent of
the bank, petitioned the Court to liquidate the accounts of
the bank. Consequently, the case was transferred from the
Criminal Division to the Civil Division before Judge Yu Zang
Tse(余長資).
After several hearings both the creditors and
the debtors agreed to settle the case outside the Court and
drew up measures by which Loh Sih Hou would make good all
the liabilities remaining unsettled with the assets of the
bank. These measures were submitted by Loh Sih Hou to the
Court for approval.
Recently Loh Sih Hou discovered that the measures
mentioned in the notices sent out by the Court to the bank's
creditors did not correspond with those which he had
submitted. Fearing that the Judge in charge of the case
was mishandling the case, Loh Sih Hou has filed a private
criminal prosecution against the Judge.
As this is the first case of its kind since the
retrocession of judicial rights in the Settlement several
years ago, the public is paying close attention to the
affair. The S.M.C., in particular, is carefully watching
the case and will detail officials to attend the Court to
take a record of the proceedings when the case comes up for
hearing. In the meantime efforts are being made to effect
a satisfactory solution before the case comes into Court.
Upon receiving Loh Sih Hou's petition, the First Special
District Court has issued summonses directing the Private
Prosecution Section of Hongkew Police Station to serve them
on all the parties concerned.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE INSPECTION OF FACTORIES.

Wong Ts Sung(王志聖), the delegate of Chinese
employers to the 19th International Labour Conference,
returned to Shanghai in the s.s. President McKinley at
7 a.m. yesterday.
Interviewed by newspaper reporters on the subject
of factory inspection in foreign Settlements, Mr. Wong said:-
"The question of factory inspection in the foreign Settlements
was repeatedly brought up by our delegates for discussion at
the conference. Although a satisfactory solution of the
question is still lacking, Mr. 'Pa-le-da'(伯勒特), Head of
the International Labour Bureau, has expressed the opinion
that a solution of the question rests with the Bureau and
that he will urge the delegates of various nations to request
their respective governments to permit inspection according
to Chinese law. In a sectional parley attended by delegates
of Great Britain, America, France, Italy, Japan and other
nations, it was decided that the delegates request their
respective governments to direct their consular officials
in Shanghai to effect an agreement."

《申报》及其他本地报纸：-

陆锡侯起诉中国法官。

继去年十月中国实业银行倒闭后，上海公共租界工部局警务处对该行董事会主席陆锡侯提出欺诈和挪用公款的指控。经过数次审讯，法院命令暂停起诉，而陆锡侯作为该行的法定代理人，向法院申请清理银行账目。因此，案件由刑事庭移交给余长资法官主持的民事庭。
经过数次审讯，债权人和债务人均同意庭外和解，并制定了由陆锡侯以银行资产清偿所有未结债务的措施。这些措施由陆锡侯提交法院批准。
近日，陆锡侯发现法院向银行债权人发出的通知中提到的措施与他提交的不符。因担心主审法官处理不当，陆锡侯已对该法官提起私人刑事自诉。
由于这是租界司法权收回数年来的首例此类案件，公众对此事密切关注。工部局尤其正在仔细监视该案，并将在案件开庭审理时派遣官员出席法庭记录诉讼过程。同时，各方正努力在案件进入法庭程序之前达成令人满意的解决方案。
第一特区地方法院收到陆锡侯的诉状后，已发出传票，指令虹口捕房私人自诉科向所有有关当事人送达。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：-

工厂视察。

参加第十九届国际劳工大会的中国雇主代表王志圣于昨日上午7时乘“麦金莱总统”号轮船返回上海。
在接受报社记者关于外国租界内工厂视察问题的采访时，王先生表示：“外国租界内的工厂视察问题已由我方代表在大会上多次提出讨论。虽然该问题尚未得到圆满解决，但国际劳工局局长‘伯勒特’先生表示意见认为，该问题的解决取决于该局，他将敦促各国代表请求各自政府允许按照中国法律进行视察。在英国、美国、法国、意大利、日本及其他国家代表参加的分段会谈中，决定由各代表请求各自政府指令其在上海的领事官员达成协议。”

S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D
August 1, 1935.
Morning Translation.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-
THE CASE AGAINST THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA.

In connection with the case against the
Industrial Bank of China, a meeting was held at 1 p.m.
yesterday in the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, North
Honan Road, to invite the views of the creditors of the
bank on the proposals submitted by Loh Sih Hou for the
payment of claims. 1,214 persons were present,
representing claims amounting to $382,745.89. Lawyer
Loh Zai Ching (陸瑞徵) attended the meeting on behalf
of Loh Sih Hou. The presidium was composed of Lee Chia
Shuen (李嘉善), Clerk of First Special District Court,
Zee Yoong Tso (徐永祚), liquidator, lawyer Lee Ting Wei
(李鼎會) and lawyer Dzien Zu Seng (錢樹声).
The programme of the meeting was as follows :-
(1) Report on the number of attendance and amount of claims.
(2) Report on the assets and liabilities of the bank.
(3) Election of supervisors.
(4) Decision on the proposals for the payment of claims.
(5) Other proposals.
When the presidium rose to make a report, most
of the creditors expressed their opposition and disorder
prevailed. Lee Chia Shuen, the Court Clerk, advised those
present to be calm and stated that they should vote on the
proposals submitted by Loh Sih Hou.
Lawyers Yu Tsong Loh (俞鐘駱), Tang Ming Sz
(唐民时) and others, acting on behalf of the creditors,
then put the following three questions to the presidium :-
(1) Whether the present liquidation refers to the Industrial
Bank of China or to Loh Sih Hou and Loh Meng Hsiang, the
two persons connected with the bank.
(2) The Industrial Bank of China was established in 1923
with a capital of $20,000,000. The paid-up Capital
was about $2,500,000. What has become of this money?
(3) A number of shareholders of the bank are prominent and
rich people and they should be held responsible for the
payment of the claims.
A section of the creditors then voiced their
disapproval of Loh Sih Hou's proposals and left the meeting.
According to information secured by a reporter
of the Chung Kuo News Agency from the office of Chartered
Accountant Zee Yoong Tso, the actual liabilities of the
bank amount to $612,981.90 while the assets total $193,199.38
only.
According to Zee Yoong Tso, creditors who
attended the meeting did not represent 75% of the total
number of creditors. The chartered accountant will apply
to the Court for instructions to-night.

《申报》及其他本地报纸：-
中国实业银行案。

就中国实业银行一案，昨日下午1时在河南北路上海总商会举行会议，征求银行债权人对陆锡侯提出的偿债方案的意见。出席会议者1,214人，代表债权金额共计382,745.89美元。律师陆瑞徵代表陆锡侯出席会议。主席团由第一特区地方法院书记官李嘉善、清算人徐永祚、律师李鼎会和律师钱树声组成。
会议议程如下：-
(1) 报告出席人数及债权金额。
(2) 报告银行资产及负债情况。
(3) 选举监察人。
(4) 对偿债方案作出决定。
(5) 其他提案。
当主席团起身作报告时，大多数债权人表示反对，现场一片混乱。法院书记官李嘉善劝告在场人员保持冷静，并表示应对陆锡侯提交的方案进行表决。
随后，代表债权人的律师俞钟骆、唐民时等人向主席团提出以下三个问题：-
(1) 目前的清算是针对中国实业银行，还是针对与该行有关的陆锡侯和陆孟祥两人。
(2) 中国实业银行成立于1923年，资本为2,000万美元。实缴资本约为250万美元。这笔钱去向如何？
(3) 该行许多股东是显赫富有的名人，他们应对偿还债务承担责任。
部分债权人随后表示不赞成陆锡侯的方案并离开会场。
据《中国新闻社》记者从会计师徐永祚办事处获得的消息，该行的实际负债总额为612,981.90美元，而资产总额仅为193,199.38美元。
据徐永祚称，出席会议的债权人并不代表债权人总数的75%。这位注册会计师将于今晚向法院请示。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：-
虞洽卿辞去轮船业主公会职务。
广东路轮船业主公会主席虞洽卿先生于7月27日提交辞呈。

July 31, 1935. Morning translation.

THE CASE AGAINST THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

In connection with the case against the
Industrial Bank of China, the Shanghai First Special
District Court on July 29 issued the following notifi-
cation to the various creditors of the banks-
"A meeting of creditors of the Industrial
Bank of China will be held at 1 p.m. July 31 at the
Chinese Chamber of Commerce, North Honan Road, to discuss
final measures to deal with the liquidation of the bank.
All creditors of the bank are requested to be present
and to bring with them proofs of their claims as well
as the admission ticket. In case they are unable to
participate in this conference, creditors are requested
to send their legal representatives with all proofs."
It is learnt that Loh Sih Hou and Loh Meng
Hsiang, the defendants in this case, have submitted to
the Shanghai First Special District Court the following
propositions for the payment of claims:-
(1) The property of the bank will be sold
and the proceeds will be used to pay 20% of the claims;
if the proceeds are insufficient for this purpose, Loh
Sih Hou will raise funds to make up the deficit.
(2) The other 20 % will be paid by monies
to be collected by the bank from its debtors by legal
process. If the sum collected be insufficient to meet
the 20% payment, Loh Sih Hou will contribute the balance.
But if the money collected from debtors is more than
enough to pay the 20%, the balance will be distributed
among the creditors.

中国实业银行案

就中国实业银行一案，上海第一特区地方法院于7月29日向该行各债权人发出如下通知-
“中国实业银行债权人会议定于7月31日下午1时在河南北路上海总商会举行，讨论处理银行清算的最终措施。请该行所有债权人携带债权证明及入场券出席。如无法参加此次会议，请债权人派遣其法律代表携带所有证明文件出席。”
据悉，本案被告陆锡侯和陆孟祥已向上海第一特区地方法院提交以下偿债方案：-
(1) 变卖银行财产，所得款项用于支付20%的债权；如果所得款项不足以支付此数额，陆锡侯将筹集资金弥补差额。
(2) 另外20%将通过银行依法向其债务人追收的款项支付。如果追收的金额不足以支付这20%，陆锡侯将补足余额。但如果从债务人处追收的款项超过支付20%所需，余额将分配给债权人。

CORRECTION

The Shanghai Nippo publishes
the following correction in connection with the article

"We withdraw the article
published on June 12 to the effect that better treatment

statements it contained are untrue."

MAINICHI, NIPPO AND NICHI-NICHI

About a week ago, the Chinese
Race Club, Bubbling Well Road, published an advertisement
inviting 15 Japanese who desire to learn horse riding.
In connection with this , Chief Inspector Fukuyama,
officer in charge of the First Section of the Japanese
Consular Police, has issued the following statement:-
"In the beginning of April, 1935 a foreign newspaper
published an article reporting that a certain Japanese
had purchased the Ying Hsiang Kiang Race Course for use
as an aerodrome. An investigation revealed that the race
course in question was the property of a certain Chinese
limited liability company. In August, 1934 a certain
American secured ten year lease from the company at a
rental of $100,000 a year for the purpose of conducting
trotting racing but this racing was prohibited by the
Shanghai City Government. Later a civil case arose
between the American citizen and the Chinese company.
The American approached a Japanese named Nakashima and
transferred the lease to him. He then organized an
association known as the "Great Eastern Athletic Association"
with a capital of $600,000 to conduct various kinds of
sports. The Association was formed by 4 Japanese and
4 Americans.
On April 17 the Japanese
Consular Police summoned Nakashima and warned him against
any connection with the enterprise because the Japanese
Consular authorities would not give permission to any person
to operate this kind of business.
Later it was reported that
a certain Chinese was attempting to secure permission from
the Chinese authorities to form a Chinese Racing Club.
Upon noticing an advertisement in Japanese newspapers
inviting Japanese jockeys, the Consular Police made an
investigation and it was ascertained that on June 11 the
Shanghai City Government had informed the Chinese that no
permission could be given for the formation of this club or
for horse trotting or any other kind of racing. The
former Chinese Racing Club was dissolved several years ago.
Even should the Chinese authorities give permission for
horse racing the Japanese authorities would never permit
any Japanese to operate this kind of business."

《日本新闻》

更正

《上海日本新闻》就6月12日刊登的关于工部局警务人员将获得更好待遇的文章，发布如下更正：
“我们撤回6月12日刊登的关于工部局警务处成员将获得更好待遇的文章，因为其中所含陈述不实。”

《每日新闻》、《日本新闻》和《日日新闻》

约一周前，位于静安寺路的中国赛马会刊登广告，招募15名希望学习骑马的日本人。就此，日本领事馆警察第一课课长福山（Fukuyama）警视发表如下声明：
“1935年4月初，一家外文报纸刊登文章，称某日本人购买了引翔港跑马场用作机场。经调查，该跑马场系某中国有限责任公司的财产。1934年8月，某美国人从该公司获得为期十年的租约，年租金为10万美元，目的是举办轻驾车赛马（trotting racing），但此类赛马被上海市政府禁止。随后，该美国公民与该中国公司之间发生了民事案件。该美国人联系了一位名叫中岛（Nakashima）的日本人，并将租约转让给他。随后，他组织了一个名为‘大东亚体育协会’的团体，资本为60万美元，以开展各类体育运动。该协会由4名日本人和4名美国人组成。
4月17日，日本领事馆警察传唤中岛，警告他不得参与该企业，因为日本领事当局不会允许任何人经营此类业务。
后来有报道称，某中国人正试图从中国当局获得许可，成立一个中国赛马会。领事馆警察注意到日文报纸上刊登了招募日本骑师的广告，遂进行调查，并查明上海市政府已于6月11日通知该中国人，不准许成立该俱乐部，也不准许进行轻驾车赛马或任何其他类型的赛马。原中国赛马会已于数年前解散。即使中国当局批准赛马，日本当局也绝不会允许任何日本人经营此类业务。”

June 14, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:-

THE AFFAIRS OF THE CHINA INDUSTRIAL BANK

The China Industrial Bank which closed down on October 11, 1934, is now being liquidated.
Loh Sih Hou (罗嗣侯), Manager of the Bank, has suggested the following measures to the 1st Special District Court to settle the accounts:-
1) That creditors of the Bank be refunded 40% of their accounts in two equal instalments.
2) That the property of the Bank be sold and the proceeds be used to pay the first instalment. If the proceeds from the sale are insufficient, the deficit will be made good by Loh Sih Hou.
3) That creditors of the Bank submit claims to the debtors of the Bank. The proceeds are to be used to pay 20% of the claims of the creditors and if there be any surplus, it will be distributed amongst the creditors themselves in proportion to their share. But if the sum is insufficient to meet 20% of the claims, the deficit will be made good by Loh Sih Hou.
Yu Foong (余奉), one of the creditors of the Bank, declares that the Court has not yet approved the measures. They will be discussed at a general meeting of creditors to be held on July 31. They will probably be opposed.

China Times and other local newspapers:-

CZECKOSLOVAKIA AND CHINA

Czeckoslovakia recently notified the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to the effect that Chinese in Czeckoslovakia will be extended the privilege of suing in forma pauperis provided that a similar privilege is extended by the Chinese Government to citizens of Czeckoslovakia in China.
The Judicial Yuan has decided to accept the suggestion and has notified the courts to permit Czeckoslovakian citizens to sue in forma pauperis from now on.

《时报》及其他本地报纸：

中国工业银行事宜

于1934年10月11日停业的中国工业银行，目前正在进行清算。该行经理罗嗣侯向第一特区地方法院提出以下措施以结清账目：
1) 向该行债权人分两期等额退还其债权的40%。
2) 变卖该行财产，所得款项用于支付第一期退款。若变卖所得不足，差额由罗嗣侯补足。
3) 该行债权人向该行债务人提交索赔。所得款项用于支付债权人债权的20%，若有盈余，则按份额比例在债权人之间分配。但若金额不足以支付债权的20%，差额由罗嗣侯补足。
该行债权人之一余奉声明，法院尚未批准这些措施。这些措施将在定于7月31举行的债权人大会上讨论。它们可能会遭到反对。

《时报》及其他本地报纸：

捷克斯洛伐克与中国

捷克斯洛伐克最近通知外交部，称在捷克斯洛伐克的中国人将被给予诉讼费减免（in forma pauperis）的特权，前提是中国政府也给予在华捷克斯洛伐克公民同样的特权。
司法院已决定接受该建议，并通知各法院，从现在起允许捷克斯洛伐克公民享受诉讼费减免待遇。

June 12, 1935.                          Morning translation.

THE BAN ON TROTTING RACES

    On June 11, the Shanghai City Government
issued the following instructions to the Ying Hsiang
Kiang Race Course:-
    "It has been ascertained that certain persons
under the auspices of the China Race Club have held
horse trotting races on the Ying Hsiang Kiang Race Course.
The City Government has already issued an order prohibiting
such races.
    "According to reports received, certain persons
are making preparations to hold further horse trotting
races on the Ying Hsiang Kiang Race Course. This is
contrary to the Government's order. It is hereby
notified that if an attempt is made to hold trotting races
on the Race Course, the City Government will punish without
leniency all persons directly or indirectly connected with
the Race Course.
    "In addition to instructing the Bureau of
Public Safety to keep a close watch, the City Government
now orders the Ying Hsiang Kiang Race Course to observe
the order."

1935年6月12日。                          晨间译件。

禁止轻驾车赛马

    6月11日，上海市政府向引翔港跑马场发出如下指令：
    “经查实，某些人在中国赛马会的名义下，在引翔港跑马场举行轻驾车赛马。市政府已发布命令禁止此类赛马。
    “据收到的报告，某些人正筹备在引翔港跑马场再次举行轻驾车赛马。此举违反政府命令。特此通知，若有人试图在跑马场举行轻驾车赛马，市政府将严惩所有直接或间接与跑马场有关的人员，绝不宽贷。
    “除指令公安局严密监视外，市政府现命令引翔港跑马场遵守该命令。”

第一特区地方法院关于已停业的中国工业银行的公告

“第一特区地方法院第19746号公告
“经审计已停业的中国工业银行账目，查明该行资产为193,199.38美元，负债为812,981.90美元，赤字为619,782.52美元。特此通知该行债权人于7月10日前向审计员 Zi Yung Zo ( )（地址：爱多亚路123号）登记。”

《时报》、《大美晚报》及《顺时电讯社》股东大会

《时报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下广告：
“时报有限公司股东大会将于6月16日下午2时在爱多亚路160号举行。将讨论公司重要事务，并重新选举董事会成员。”

April 30, 1935.
Afternoon Translation.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:-

THE CHINESE IN SIAM

In connection with the promulgation
of harsh regulations restricting the educational, industrial
and commercial enterprises of Chinese residing in Siam,
the Federation of Overseas Chinese in Shanghai will convene
a meeting of representatives of various local bodies on
May 1. On April 29 the Federation sent the following
circular letter to the Chambers of Commerce, Rice Dealers'
Associations and other public bodies in Shanghai, Canton,
Hongkong, Amoy and Swatow:-
"We are in receipt of the following
letter from the Petition Group of the Overseas Chinese in
Siam:-
"The harsh regulations restricting the industrial
and commercial enterprises of Chinese residing in
Siam and the rules governing Chinese education and
immigration, recently promulgated by the Siamese
Government, will reduce the Chinese in Siam to the
status of slaves. You are requested to draw
the attention of the Chinese Authorities and the
people to this matter and to render every possible
assistance to us!.
"There has been no formal diplomatic
relations between China and Siam so that the latter has had
a free hand and is oppressing the Chinese in her country.
In view of the importance of the present dispute, you are
kindly requested to render assistance by drawing the
attention of the people to the matter and urging the
National Government to open negotiations with Siam for the
cancellation of these harsh regulations."

Sin Wen Pao publishes the following article :-

A NEW RACE CLUB BEING ORGANIZED

Certain Chinese and Japanese have
jointly organized a race club in the Yinghsiangkiang Race
Course. The new club will accept persons of any
nationality and has no connection with the trotting club
formerly established in the Yinghsiangkiang Race Course.
It will be registered according to Chinese law.
The Club will commence to function
when its registration certificate has been received from
the Shanghai City Government.
The above information is said
to have been released by Tsung Tao (中岛), a Japanese,
who is Vice-Chairman of the club. He is staying in
Room No.616 Cathay Hotel.

D6225
pages.zh:
1935年4月30日。
午后译件。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

暹罗的华人

鉴于暹罗颁布了限制当地华人教育、工业和商业企业的严厉法规，上海华侨联合会将于5月1日召集各地方团体代表开会。4月29日，该联合会向上海、广州、香港、厦门和汕头的商会、米业公会及其他公共团体发出如下通函：
“我们收到暹罗华侨请愿团的如下来信：
‘暹罗政府最近颁布的限制当地华人工商企业以及管理华人教育和移民的严厉法规，将使暹罗华人沦为奴隶地位。恳请提请中国当局和民众注意此事，并给予我们一切可能的协助！。
‘中国与暹罗之间没有正式的外交关系，因此后者得以肆意妄为，压迫其境内的华人。鉴于当前争端的重要性，恳请协助提请民众注意此事，并敦促国民政府与暹罗展开谈判，以取消这些严厉法规。’”

《新闻报》发表如下文章：

正在组建的新赛马会

某些中国人和日本人联合在引翔港跑马场组织了一个赛马会。新赛马会将接纳任何国籍的人士，与此前在引翔港跑马场成立的轻驾车赛马会没有任何关联。该会将依据中国法律注册。
该会在收到上海市政府颁发的注册证书后即开始运作。
据悉，上述信息由该会副主席、日本人中岛（Tsung Tao）发布。他住在华懋饭店616室。

D6225

April 28, 1935. Morning Translation.

Shanghai Morning Post (official organ of Gen.Chiang Kai Shek)
and other local newspapers:

WORLD TROTTING CLUB BEING FORMED

A World Trotting Club (世界賽馬会) is being
organized in Shanghai by certain Chinese, Japanese and
other foreigners. It will be located at the Yingziangkiang
Race Course. The World Trotting Club has no connection
with the International Trotting Club.
The management of the World Trotting Club will
first apply to the Chinese Government for registration
and the Club will open for business as soon as this
approval has been secured.
The Club will pay a tax amounting to between
$200,000 to $300,000 to the Chinese Authorities.

Shanghai Morning Post (official organ of Gen.Chiang Kai Shek)
and other local newspapers:

MEETING OF THE SHANGHAI AIR DEFENCE ASSOCIATION

The Shanghai Air Defence Association held a
meeting on April 25 at the Shanghai City Government.
Representatives from the local Tangpu, the Woosung-Shanghai
Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters, the Bureau of
Education and other Chinese official organs were present.
Mayor Wu Te Chen was in the chair.
The following resolutions were discussed and
passed:-
1) That a Special Committee of the Association be
inaugurated on May 1.
2) That a Shanghai Citizens' Air Defence & Protection
Corps be formed.
3) That the Peace Preservation Corps, the Chinese Boy
Scouts Committee and the Bureau of Education draw up
measures for anti-air raid drill.

Iron News (铁报) published the following comment on April 27:-

FOREIGN SETTLEMENT AUTHORITIES AND AMUSEMENT RESORTS

The Small World Amusement Resort (小世界), the
only one in the Chinese City, has suddenly closed its doors.
It has been ascertained that the closing of this resort
is not due to trade depression, but to the severe
restrictions placed on it by the Chinese Authorities on
account of the obscene plays which the resort had been
staging.
The Settlement Authorities pay close attention
to offences against morality but they are not so strict
in dealing with amusement resorts. We hope the Settlement
Authorities will pay stricter attention to these resorts
in future.

1935年4月28日。晨间译件。

《上海晨报》（蒋介石将军的官方喉舌）及其他本地报纸：

世界轻驾车赛马会正在组建

某些中国人、日本人和其他外国人正在上海组建一个世界轻驾车赛马会（世界賽馬会）。该会将设在引翔港跑马场。世界轻驾车赛马会与国际轻驾车赛马会没有任何关联。
世界轻驾车赛马会管理层将首先向中国政府申请注册，一旦获得批准，该会即开业运营。
该会将向中国当局缴纳20万至30万美元的税款。

《上海晨报》（蒋介石将军的官方喉舌）及其他本地报纸：

上海防空协会会议

上海防空协会于4月25日在上海市政府举行会议。来自本地塘浦、吴淞-上海驻军司令总部、教育局及其他中国官方机构的代表出席了会议。市长吴铁城担任主席。
会议讨论并通过以下决议：
1) 于5月1日成立协会特别委员会。
2) 组建上海市民防空防护团。
3) 由保安队、中国童子军委员会和教育局制定防空演习措施。

《铁报》于4月27日发表如下评论：

租界当局与娱乐场所

位于华界的唯一娱乐场所“小世界”突然关闭。经查实，该娱乐场所的关闭并非由于商业萧条，而是因其上演淫秽剧目，受到中国当局的严厉限制所致。
租界当局密切关注妨害风化罪，但在处理娱乐场所方面并不如此严格。我们希望租界当局今后对这些娱乐场所予以更严格的关注。

D.62 5
April 2, 19..
Afternoon translation.

TROTTING CLUB SOLD TO JAPANESE

Some time ago, Loh Sih Hoi ( 陸  海 )
established an International Trotting Club at Kiangwan.
Jockeys were imported and horses were purchased from abroad.
Owing to being heavily involved in connection with the
failure of the China Industrial Bank, Loh did not carry
out his scheme to the end.
Several months ago he repatriated
the jockeys but kept the horses at Kiangwan with the
intention of making a new start after the case in connection
with the China Industrial Bank had been brought to an end.
As there seemed to be no prospect of
the business being put through owing to the high cost of
maintaining the horses, Loh determined to sell the horses.
At this point a Japanese who is planning the organization
of a race-course approached Loh with an offer to purchase
the horses and trotting vehicles from him.
It is now reported that Loh and the
Japanese have reached an agreement, and a new race course
will come into existence in the immediate future.
Whether or not this race-course will retain the name of
International Trotting Club is at present unknown.
pages.zh:
D.62 5
19..年4月2日。
下午译件。

赛马会售予日本人

前此，陆海（Loh Sih Hoi）在江湾创办了一家国际赛马会。从国外引进了骑师并购买了马匹。由于与中国工业银行倒闭案牵连甚深，陆未能将其计划贯彻到底。数月前，他将骑师遣送回国，但将马匹留在江湾，打算在与中工银案了结后重新开始。鉴于维持马匹费用高昂，业务似乎无望推进，陆决定出售马匹。此时，一名正筹划组建跑马场的日本人向陆提出购买其马匹及赛马车辆的要约。现据报，陆与该日本人已达成协议，不久后将出现一个新的跑马场。该跑马场是否会保留“国际赛马会”之名，目前尚不清楚。

on April 20:

LAND OWNER OPPOSES LEASE

Loh Sih Hou has leased the Yinghsiangkiang
Race-Course to a Japanese organization known as the
Metropolitan Sporting Association. It will be formally
inaugurated on May 2.

《东方日报》于4月20日刊登了以下文章：

地主反对租赁

陆士厚（Loh Sih Hou）已将引翔港跑马场租给一个名为“都市体育协会”的日本组织。该组织将于5月2日正式成立。
据悉，土地所有者沈（Shen，原文空缺）已通知陆，因租赁未经其同意，故表示反对。

April 17, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

Ta Mei Wei i ao published the following article
on April 16, 1935.

JAPANESE LEASES CHINESE JOCKEY CLUB'S
YANGTZEPOO RACE TRACK

In connection with the leasing of the Chinese
Jockey Club's Yangtzepoo Race Track by the Japanese-
controlled Great Eastern Sporting Association, Mr. Nagajima,
who was specially sent here from Kobe to make the deal,
made the following statement yesterday:-

"The Japanese have raised a sum of $600,000
to organize a Great Eastern Sporting Association Ltd. and
have obtained the lease of the property of the Chinese
Jockey Club at Ying Hsiang Kong and the equipment belonging
to the Metropolitan Sporting Association. The period of
the lease starts from April 1, 1934 and expires on July 31,
1944. There is absolutely no truth in the rumour
prevailing in Shanghai that the land will be converted into
a base for the use of the Japanese Landing Party in
Shanghai, as the property is being leased for the exclusive
purpose of holding trotting races and various other kinds
of sport. There will be eight directors on the Board
of Directors of the Great Eastern Sporting Association,
four of whom will be of Japanese nationality, the others
will be either British or American who must be Shanghai
residents. I understand that the names of the Board of
Directors will be published within the next three or
four days."

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER / APR 18 1935 / (CRIME BRANCH)）

1935年4月17日。下午译件。

《大美晚报》（Ta Mei Wei i ao）于1935年4月16日刊登了以下文章。

日本人租赁中国赛马会杨树浦跑马场

就日本控制的“大东体育协会”租赁中国赛马会杨树浦跑马场一事，专门从神户派来达成此项交易的永岛（Nagajima，音译）先生昨日发表如下声明：

“日本人已筹集60万美元，组建了‘大东体育协会有限公司’，并获得了中国赛马会在引翔港（Ying Hsiang Kong）的物业以及属于‘都市体育协会’的设备之租赁权。租赁期自1934年4月1日起，至1944年7月31日止。上海流传的所谓该土地将被改建为供上海日本海军陆战队使用的基地之谣言，纯属子虚乌有，因为该物业租赁的唯一目的是举行赛马及其他各类体育运动。大东体育协会董事会将有八名董事，其中四人为日本籍，其余为英籍或美籍，且必须是上海居民。据悉，董事会成员名单将在未来三至四天内公布。”

（印：副警务处长 / 1935年4月18日 / （刑事科））

January 29, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

Society Evening News ( ...... ):

THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

Some days ago, the creditors of the Industrial Bank of China held a meeting at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce. As Loh Shih Hcu, ( ...... ) the Managing-Director of the Bank, who was present at the meeting, refused to pay 50% of the claims, the creditors have complained to the Court.
In an interview, Judge Yu Chang Tse ( ...... ) stated that the Special District Court will publish a notice after two weeks announcing that they may file petitions with the Court demanding the settlement of their claims.

Correction

The following letter sent by Sun Chiun Sze ( ...... ) and other lawyers on behalf of the creditors of the Industrial Bank of China is published in the correspondence columns of the China Times and other local newspapers:-
"Yih Chee ( ...... ), Nan Chee ( ...... ) and other clients have informed us that the report of the meeting of the creditors of the Industrial Bank of China published in the newspapers is not accurate. The meeting held on January 26 at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce was attended by nine representatives of the creditors. Loh Shih Hou and his lawyer Wu Ling Kwen ( ...... ) were also present. Loh Shih Hou declared that he would pay only 20% of the claims before Settlement Day. As Loh Shih Hou has failed to keep his promise to satisfy 50% of the claims and as he was abusive towards the creditors and had declared that he was prepared to go to prison, all the creditors present became very angry, and Yih Chee, Nan Chee and other creditors left the meeting after a recorder of the Special District Court, who was in attendance, had left. Yih Chee, Nan Chee and other creditors were very surprised to read a report in the newspapers to the effect that Loh Shih Hou made his escape from the meeting in disguise after which the creditors agreed to accept the offer of Loh Shih Hou to pay 20% of the claims and demanded that Loh Shih Hou publish a reply in newspapers within two days. Either the report of the proceedings had been deliberately distorted or the illegal resolution to accept 20% of the claims was passed by a small section of the creditors or their representatives.
"Our clients state that they have jointly petitioned the Special District Court to deal with the case in accordance with law. They request that a correction be published by the newspapers for the information of the public."

D.C. (......)

1935年1月29日。下午译件。

《社会晚报》（Society Evening News，原文不清）：

中国工业银行

日前，中国工业银行的债权人在上海总商会举行会议。由于出席会议的该行总经理罗士厚（Loh Shih Hcu，原文拼写如此）拒绝支付50%的索赔额，债权人已向法庭投诉。
法官余长泽（Yu Chang Tse，音译）在一次采访中表示，特区法院将在两周后发布公告，宣布债权人可向法院提交诉状，要求清偿其债权。

更正

孙俊士（Sun Chiun Sze，音译）等律师代表中国工业银行债权人致《字林西报》及当地其他报纸通讯栏的信函刊登如下：
“益记（Yih Chee，音译）、南记（Nan Chee，音译）及其他委托人告知我们，报纸上刊登的关于中国工业银行债权人会议的报道不准确。1月26日在上海总商会举行的会议有九名债权人代表出席。罗士厚及其律师吴林坤（Wu Ling Kwen，音译）亦在场。罗士厚宣称，在结算日之前，他仅能支付20%的债权。由于罗士厚未能信守偿付50%债权的承诺，且对债权人出言不逊，并声称准备入狱，所有在场的债权人均极为愤怒。在出席的特区法院书记员离开后，益记、南记及其他债权人随即退席。益记、南记及其他债权人惊讶地读到报纸报道称，罗士厚乔装逃离会议，随后债权人同意接受罗士厚支付20%债权的提议，并要求罗士厚在两天内在报纸上发表答复。这要么是会议进程报道被故意歪曲，要么是该非法决议由少数债权人或其代表通过。
“我们的委托人声明，他们已联合向特区法院请愿，要求依法处理此案。他们请求报纸刊登更正，以告公众。”

January 17, 1931.
Morning Translation
Shun Kuo and other local newspapers.

MEETING OF CREDITORS OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA.

The creditors group of the Industrial Bank of China held a meeting at 2 p.m. yesterday at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, North Bonham road. Some 500 persons were present. In Shiu Kwang, 李/ Loh Ka Heng 羅家衡 and Chien Chung Lin 錢仲麟 presided.
Lawyer Tung Yue 董俞 made a report on the negotiations. Lawyer Wu Lin Kuin, 吳林坤 representative of Loh Shih Hou, 羅士厚 then made the following statement: "Loh Shih Hou has been released on bail for the past two weeks. Before he was bailed out, he came to an agreement with the creditors to pay half of his debts. However, since his release, he has been trying to raise a loan but his efforts have, so far, proved unsuccessful. Furthermore, the organizations from which he had anticipated to negotiate a loan have recently gone out of business. He has now secured a sum of $40,000. For this reason, the following proposition is hereby submitted to the creditors:-
1. That 20% of all claims below $500 be first repaid (The total amount of such claims is estimated at about $40,000). The settlement of claims above $500 (totalling about $200,000) will be deferred for the time being, but if the creditors press for payment, Loh will be prepared to pay first 10% of the claims.
2. The title-deeds borrowed from various parties by Loh Shih Hou will be handed over to the creditors who may mortgage them with banks for cash for distribution among the creditors.
"If this proposition is accepted by the creditors, it can be carried out immediately, but if it is opposed, then Loh Shih Hou is prepared to return to jail".

A creditor here said, "Before Loh Shih Hou was released on bail, his lawyer stated that Loh had already obtained funds from various sources, and that if he be released, he would be able to pay 50% of all claims at once. The lawyer even mentioned that the money had already been deposited in a bank for this purpose and that it would be paid out after Loh's release. Unexpectedly Loh has now eaten up his words! We cannot be misled in this manner. We insist on settling this case with Loh in accordance with law."
All the creditors present applauded the speaker. Great disorder then ensued. Loh Shih Hou suddenly stood up and uttered some abusive words. This aroused the anger of the creditors some of whom came forward to argue with him. Loh Shih Hou's brother attempted to mediate in the dispute but was mistaken by the creditors for Loh Shih Hou himself because his appearance and clothing were somewhat the same. As he was being surrounded by the creditors, Loh Shih Hou seized the opportunity to slip out of the meeting place in different clothing. The creditors insisted that 50% of their claims be paid. Loh's party offered to pay only 20%. Wu Fang and eight other lawyers of the creditors then withdrew. There was no chance for a settlement. Loh's wife then took the platform and tendered an apology.
pages.zh:
1931年1月17日。
上午译件
《顺国报》（Shun Kuo，音译）及其他当地报纸。

中国工业银行债权人会议。

中国工业银行债权人团于昨日下午2时在北邦汉路（North Bonham road）上海总商会举行会议。约500人出席。李/罗家衡（Loh Ka Heng）和钱仲麟（Chien Chung Lin）主持。
律师董俞（Tung Yue，音译）报告了谈判情况。随后，罗士厚（Loh Shih Hou）的代表律师吴林坤（Wu Lin Kuin，音译）发表如下声明：“罗士厚在过去两周内已获保释。在保释前，他与债权人达成协议，偿还一半债务。然而，自获释以来，他一直试图筹借贷款，但迄今未果。此外，他原预期与之洽谈贷款的机构最近已停业。他现已筹得4万美元。为此，现向债权人提出如下提议：
1. 首先偿还所有500美元以下的债权的20%（此类债权总额估计约为4万美元）。500美元以上的债权（总额约20万美元）的清偿暂时推迟，但如果债权人催付，罗准备先支付这些债权的10%。
2. 罗士厚向各方借用的地契将移交给债权人，债权人可将其向银行抵押以换取现金，并在债权人中进行分配。
“如果债权人接受此提议，即可立即执行；但如果遭到反对，那么罗士厚准备返回监狱”。

此时一名债权人说：“在罗士厚获保释前，他的律师称罗已从各处获得资金，如果获释，他能一次性支付所有债权的50%。律师甚至提到，为此目的资金已存入银行，将在罗获释后支付。没想到罗现在食言了！我们不能这样被误导。我们坚持依法与罗解决此案。”
所有在场债权人为发言者鼓掌。随后现场大乱。罗士厚突然站起，口出恶言。这激怒了债权人，其中一些人上前与他争辩。罗士厚的兄弟试图调解纠纷，但因外貌和衣着与罗颇为相似，被债权人误认为是罗士厚本人。当他被债权人包围时，罗士厚趁机换装溜出会场。债权人坚持要求支付其债权的50%。罗方仅愿支付20%。吴芳（Wu Fang，音译）及其他八名债权人律师随即退席。和解无望。随后罗的妻子上台致歉。

January 27, 1935. Morning Translation.

The creditors decided to demand that 50 per cent
of all claims below $500 be paid and 20 per cent of all
claims above $500. The balance is to be refunded after
the date of the General Settlement of accounts. Loh Sih
Hou will be asked to give a reply in the newspapers within
two days. The meeting then terminated.

China Times and other local newspapers:

PROVISIONS MERCHANTS ADVISED TO REFRAIN FROM IMPORTING
FOREIGN RICE

The Executive Committee and the Supervisory
Committee of the Provisions Merchants' Association held
a meeting at 4 p.m. yesterday at the Provisions Exchange
on Min Kuo Road. About 20 persons were present. Koo
Tsing I (顾清一) presided.
After the Chairman had warned the meeting that
unless the importation of foreign rice be stopped, the
price of Chinese rice would drop so heavily that the
livelihood of the rural population would be affected, the
meeting passed a resolution that an investigation into
the quantities of rice imported by foreign companies
be made; that a report on the total quantity of rice be
submitted to the Bureau of Social Affairs; and that a
notification be circulated to the members of the Association
not to import any more foreign rice.

1935年1月27日。上午译件。

债权人决定要求支付所有500美元以下债权的50%，以及所有500美元以上债权的20%。余额将在总账结算日后退还。要求罗士厚在两天内在报纸上给予答复。会议随即结束。

《字林西报》及其他当地报纸：

劝告粮食商勿进口洋米

粮食业同业公会执行委员会和监察委员会于昨日下午4时在民国路粮食交易所举行会议。约20人出席。顾清一（Koo Tsing I）主持。
主席警告会议称，除非停止进口洋米，否则华米价格将大幅下跌，从而影响农村人口的生计。随后会议通过决议：调查外国公司进口的大米数量；向社会局提交大米总量报告；并向公会会员发布通知，不再进口任何洋米。

pages.en:
THE SHANGHAI SUNDAY TIMES, JANUARY 27, 1935

Crowds Chase
Ex-Bank Head
Down Streets

Enraged Creditors Are
After Sums Deposited
In Industrial Bank

CHARGE REPUDIATION
OF HIS PROMISE

Meeting In Chinese Chamber
Ends In Confusion When
Offer Is Rejected

Enraged at his offer for
only part repayment of funds
deposited in the Industrial
Bank of China, an offer
which they declared violated
an earlier promise, creditors
of the suspended institution
yesterday broke into turmoil
during a meeting at the Chin-
ese Chamber of Commerce
and pursued the luckless
managing director, Mr. S. H.
Loh, through the streets. He
escaped from the place fol-
lowed by infuriated crowds
who demanded repayment of
their deposits in order to
meet obligations on the Lunar
New Year.

Mr. Loh was specially released
from the custody of the First
Special District Court to attend
the meeting of creditors, some 300
of whom were present in the
Chamber at 3 p.m. The crowd rose
in anger as Mr. Loh explained
that he could not pay half of the
$400,000 of outstanding debts. He
said that he had made the state-
ment in court believing that he
could raise the amount from
friends and relatives, but had
failed. He offered to pay 20 per
cent. to depositors of more than
$1,000 and 60 per cent. to those
who deposited less than $500.

Opposition to this offer was
voiced from every corner of the
big hall. Despite the efforts of
three larger creditors, who formed
the presidium of the meeting,
quiet could not be obtained and
people rose to shout and harass
the former bank head. They loud-
ly demanded that he fulfill the
promise which he had made in
court.

The meeting ended in such con-
fusion that it was impossible to
learn how and if the dispute would
be settled. It was rumoured that
the creditors might ask Mr. Loh
to insert notices in the newspapers
apologizing for his alleged breach
of faith.

File
Hill
pages.zh:
《上海星期泰晤士报》，1935年1月27日

人群沿街
追逐前银行行长

愤怒的债权人
追讨存于
中国工业银行的款项

指控其背弃
承诺

在华商会举行的会议
因提议被拒而陷入混乱

债权人对这位暂停营业的机构负责人仅部分偿还在中国工业银行存款的提议感到愤怒，他们称该提议违背了早前的承诺。昨日，在中国商会举行的会议期间，债权人陷入骚乱，并沿街追逐不幸的总经理罗士厚（S. H. Loh）先生。他在愤怒人群的追随下逃离现场，这些人要求偿还存款，以履行农历新年的债务义务。

罗先生经第一特区地方法院特别释放，出席债权人会议，约有300名债权人于下午3时出现在商会。当罗先生解释他无法支付40万美元未偿债务的一半时，人群愤怒起来。他说，他在法庭上发表该声明时，以为能从亲友处筹得这笔款项，但未能成功。他提议向存款超过1,000美元的储户支付20%，向存款少于500美元的储户支付60%。

大厅各处均有人对此提议表示反对。尽管由三名较大债权人组成的会议主席团努力维持秩序，但现场无法恢复平静，人们起身呼喊并骚扰这位前银行行长。他们大声要求他履行在法庭上作出的承诺。

会议在如此混乱中结束，以至于无法得知争端将如何以及是否得到解决。有传言称，债权人可能会要求罗先生在报纸上刊登启事，为其所谓的背信行为道歉。

档案
希尔（Hill）

January 24, 1935. Afternoon Translation

Sin Wan Pao (Brief Comment):-

"OUR GOOD NEIGHBOUR"

K.Hirota, the Japanese Foreign Minister, at
the opening of the conference recently, delivered a
lengthy speech which was full of words about peace,
good friendship etc. Seemingly, his speech was made
in good faith; however, the more we listen to it, the
more uneasy we feel because all what he spoke about is
without foundation. Fundamentally, the Japanese have
no idea about peace and good relationship.
Hirota called his country the "good neighbour"
of China. He said that he hoped China would be restored
to peace and safety at an early date, and such a hope
remained cordially in his mind. We appreciate very
much indeed these good wishes of the Japanese Foreign
Minister. China is really too lucky because she has
such a "good neighbour" which is now sincerely longing
for a peaceful condition in the country. But there
is one question we want to put to our "good neighbour",
that is, what is the principal cause of the "unpeaceful"
and unsafe" condition in our country and who is the
disturber or the instigator that causes China to
encounter such a national difficulty?
We do not expect our neighbour to help us and
pity us, but at the same time, we do not want our
neighbour to use sweet and "honeyed" words to cheat us,
while, in fact, we are all the time in danger of being
attacked and robbed of our belongings by this neighbour.
As our "good neighbour" has asked us to devote our
energy towards bringing about peace, we will certainly
follow his advice. But what we will endeavour to do
does not concern pretended friendship, or a sort of
denatured form of submission. What we shall strive for
is to tighten the guard on our door, and to rearrange
our homes. We will be prepared for such a day when
we can show some vigour to our "good neighbour".

CREDITORS OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA
TO HOLD MEETING
The Creditors Group of the Industrial Bank of
China publishes the following notice in the advertisement
columns of the Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-
"This Group will hold a meeting at 2 p.m.
January 26 at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce. The
First Special District Court has been requested to
detail officials to supervise the proceedings. All
creditors of the bank should bring their certificates
when attending the meeting."

1935年1月24日。下午译件

《新闻报》（简评）：-

“我们的好邻居”

日本外相广田弘毅在近期会议开幕时，发表了一篇长篇演说，通篇充斥着关于和平、友好等辞藻。表面上看，他的演讲似乎是出于诚意；然而，我们听得越多，越感到不安，因为他所说的一切均无事实依据。从根本上说，日本人并无和平与良好关系之概念。
广田称其国家为中国的“好邻居”。他说，他希望中国早日恢复和平与安全，这种愿望一直诚挚地存于他心中。我们确实非常感激这位日本外相的良好祝愿。中国确实太幸运了，因为拥有这样一位如今真诚渴望国家和平局面的“好邻居”。但是，有一个问题我们要问我们的“好邻居”，那就是，造成我国“不和平”和“不安全”状况的主要原因是什么？是谁作为扰乱者或煽动者，导致中国遭遇这样的国难？
我们不指望邻居帮助我们或怜悯我们，但同时，我们也不希望邻居用甜言蜜语和“蜜糖般”的话语欺骗我们，而事实上，我们时刻处于被这位邻居攻击和抢劫财物的危险之中。既然我们的“好邻居”要求我们致力于实现和平，我们当然会听从他的建议。但我们将努力做的，并不涉及虚假的友谊，或某种变相的屈服。我们要 striving 做的是加强门户守卫，并整顿家园。我们将做好准备，以便在有朝一日能向我们的“好邻居”展示一些力量。

中国实业银行债权人将举行会议

中国实业银行债权人团在《申报》及其他本地报纸的广告栏刊登如下通知：-
“本团将于1月26日下午2时在总商会举行会议。已请求第一特区地方法院派员监督会议进程。所有银行债权人在出席会议时应携带凭证。”

January 23, 1935. Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

Loh Shih Hcu (陸錫侯), the Managing-Director of the Industrial Bank of China, was detained by the First Special District Court after the Bank had suspended business.
At a hearing held the other day, Loh Shih Hcu agreed to settle 50 per cent of the amount of the claims and the Court permitted him to be released in order to enable him to secure the money.
At 3 p.m. yesterday, the Court held another hearing of the case. Loh Shih Hcu told the Court that he would be unable to settle 50 per cent of the amount of the claims, whereupon nine representatives of the creditors of the Bank objected.
Judge Yu Chang Tse (余長質) ordered the case to be remanded. Loh Shih Hcu was again ordered to satisfy 50 per cent of the claims.
A meeting of the creditors of the Bank will be held on Saturday at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, North Soochow Road, to discuss the minimum amount which could be accepted in regard to their claims.

Sin Wan Pao Evening Edition (23/1/35):

DISCOVERY OF RED PILL FACTORY AND RESULT OF COURT PROCEEDINGS

With reference to the discovery by Police of the Chengtu Road Station of a red pill factory at House No.10 Chien Foh Li Alleyway (全福里), off Chengtu Road and of a sales office at No.20 Chong Chow Villa, bubbling Well Road, another hearing was heard this morning when 16 persons were accused in the matter.
The Municipal Advocate told the Court that the Police had ascertained that House No.20 Chong Chow Villa was used as a red pill factory, while House No.10 Chien Foh Li Alleyway, off Chengtu Road, was rented as a sales office. These two establishments were operated by a foreigner named "Tong-Kan" 湯根 and a Chinese named Hau Feng San (許鳳山), both of whom were not in custody.
When Judge Wu Ding Chee (吳廷琪) questioned the accused, they stated that besides the two principals, "Tong-Kan" and Hau Feng San, there was another principal, a Chinese named Wong Tse Sung (汪子生).
Wong Tse Sung is a detective sergeant of the Shanghai Municipal Police attached to West Hongkew Station. He has been in the Force for a number of years and absconded after the discovery of the case.
The Court acquitted three accused and sentenced the others to various terms of imprisonment. The manufacturing equipment and quantities of red pills were ordered to be confiscated.

1935年1月23日。上午译件。

《时报》及其他本地报纸：

中国实业银行

中国实业银行总经理陆锡侯（Loh Shih Hcu）在该行停业后被第一特区地方法院拘留。
在前几日举行的庭审中，陆锡侯同意清偿索赔金额的50%，法院准许其释放，以便他筹集资金。
昨日下午3时，法院再次开庭审理此案。陆锡侯告诉法院，他无法清偿索赔金额的50%，对此，银行的九名债权人代表表示反对。
法官余长质（Yu Chang Tse）下令将案件延期审理。陆锡侯再次被责令清偿50%的索赔款。
银行债权人会议将于星期六在北苏州路总商会举行，讨论就其索赔可接受的最低金额。

《新闻报》晚版（1935年1月23日）：

查获红丸厂及法庭诉讼结果

鉴于成都路巡捕房在成都路全福里10号发现一家红丸厂，并在泡井路崇州别墅20号发现一处销售处，今晨就此案对16名被告进行了另一次庭审。
公诉人告诉法院，警方已查明崇州别墅20号被用作红丸厂，而成都路旁全福里10号则被租作销售处。这两处场所由一名名为“汤根”（Tong-Kan）的外国人和一名名为许凤山（Hau Feng San）的中国人经营，二人均未在押。
当法官吴廷琪（Wu Ding Chee）讯问被告时，他们陈述除两名主犯“汤根”和许凤山外，还有另一名主犯，即名为汪子生（Wong Tse Sung）的中国人。
汪子生是上海公共租界工部局警务处西虹口分局的侦探巡长。他在警队服役多年，案发后潜逃。
法院宣判三名被告无罪，其余被告判处不同期限的监禁。制造设备及红丸数量被命令没收。

pages.en:
SIN MUN PAO and other local newspapers(20/1/35):

THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

With reference to the closing of the Industrial
Bank of China, Judge Yu Chang Tse(余長資) of the First
Special District Court heard the case again on January 19.
Lawyers Woo Pang (郎鵬), Wong Jeong Wei (王仲桓) and
Drung Lin Sz (原霖時) representing the common creditors
of the bank (the amount due to them being some $400,000)
said that Loh Shih Hou (陸錫侯), the manager-director
of the bank, might be able to raise half the amount
provided he was released.
The Judge said that Loh Shih Hou's liabilities
amounted to some $940,000. Now the creditors to whom some
$400,000 was due agreed that Loh be released, but if he
absconded upon release, the other creditors would not be able
to recover their claims. The Judge therefore ordered that
Loh could only be released if a shop security of $200,000
was put up.
Lawyer Wu Ling Kwen (吳麟坤) representing Loh
Shih Hou said.- "With the exception of $400,000 owing to the
creditors who are present to-day, the liabilities of Loh Shih
Hou are some $300,000 out of the total amount of about
$900,000 as suitable security in the sum of $140,000 stands
to his credit in the Ningpo Commercial Bank. Loh has
provided a security of $50,000 to the Criminal Court. In
consequence his credit is now less than $100,000. The Judge
is requested to reduce the amount of the security."
After consideration, Judge Yu reduced the security
to $100,000.
Loh Shih Hou then asked that the security be
reduced to $50,000 and added that prior to the security being
put up, his three lawyers and eight or nine lawyers of the
the creditors were prepared to be responsible for him
for the time being, and that he would give himself up to
the Court in the event that the necessary security
could not be provided within three days.
The Judge, after carefully examining the
accounts of the Industrial Bank, heard the case again and
permitted Loh Shih Hou to be released on shop security of
$80,000. The Judge ordered that the shop security offered
by Loh to the Criminal Court be increased by $30,000 so
that Loh had to provide a new security of $50,000. The
necessary security was ordered to be provided within three
days.
Loh Shih Hou was then released.
pages.zh:
《申闻报》及其他本地报纸（1935年1月20日）：

中国实业银行

关于中国实业银行停业一事，第一特区地方法院法官余长资（Yu Chang Tse）于1月19日再次审理此案。
代表银行普通债权人（欠款金额约40万元）的律师郎鵬（Woo Pang）、王仲桓（Wong Jeong Wei）和原霖時（Drung Lin Sz）表示，如果释放银行总经理陆锡侯（Loh Shih Hou），他或许能够筹得一半款项。
法官表示，陆锡侯的债务总额约为94万元。目前，欠款约40万元的债权人同意释放陆锡侯，但如果他获释后潜逃，其他债权人将无法追回其债权。因此，法官命令只有在提供20万元铺保的情况下，才能释放陆锡侯。
代表陆锡侯的律师吴麟坤（Wu Ling Kwen）表示：- “除了欠今日出席的债权人40万元外，陆锡侯在总额约90万元的债务中另有30万元负债，他在宁波商业银行有14万元存款作为适当担保。陆已向刑事法庭提供5万元担保。因此，他的信用额度现已不足10万元。恳请法官降低担保金额。”
经考虑，余法官将担保金额减至10万元。
陆锡侯随后请求将担保金额减至5万元，并补充说，在提供担保之前，他的三名律师以及债权人的八九名律师准备暂时为他作保，如果在三天内无法提供必要的担保，他将向法院投案。
法官在仔细审查中国实业银行的账目后，再次开庭审理，并准许陆锡侯以8万元铺保获释。法官命令将陆向刑事法庭提供的铺保增加3万元，因此陆需提供新的5万元担保。命令在三天内提供必要的担保。
陆锡侯随即获释。

pages.en:
January 19, 1935.                                          Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

        After the closure of the Industrial Bank of
China, Loh Shih Hou, the Managing-Director, was arrested,
and the creditors of the bank instituted civil claims
against him in the First Special District Court. The
Court appointed Judge Yu Chang Tse (余長策) as liquidator
of Loh's property.
        The day before yesterday Judge Chien Hung Yin
(錢洪音) permitted the release of Loh Shih Hou on
bail of $20,000 cash and $30,000 security in order to
enable him to settle the claims. After Loh had provided the
necessary security, he was released at 4.30 p.m. yesterday.
Later Loh appeared in the S.C. Civil Court in company
with his lawyers.
        Judge Yu Chang Tse questioned him as to whether
he had any shares in the Auditorium and the Canidrome.
        Loh replied that he had no relations with the
Auditorium, but that he held more than 1,000 shares in
Canidrome and that these shares had been mortgaged to the
Ningpo Commercial Bank for a loan of $40,000. Loh stated
that his liabilities amounted to $900,000, but sums
totalling $1,000,000 were owing to him, of which he could
collect more than $100,000. Loh added that he had
$150,000 in the Ningpo Commercial Bank, the proceeds of
a mortgage and that he had advanced $150,000 to the Chung
Yih Finance Corporation (中益信託) and his relations
had deposits totalling $100,000. There would be a shortage
of $500,000 only. He was prepared to settle 50% of the
balance of the claims ($50,000) for the time being.
        Judge Yu ordered that Loh be detained pending
an investigation as to whether or not Loh Shih Hou does
hold shares in the Auditorium.
pages.zh:
1935年1月19日。                                          上午译件。

《时报》及其他本地报纸：

中国实业银行

        中国实业银行停业后，总经理陆锡侯被捕，银行债权人在第一特区地方法院对他提起民事诉讼。法院任命余长策（Yu Chang Tse）法官为陆财产的清算人。
        前天，钱洪音（Chien Hung Yin）法官准许陆锡侯以2万元现金保释金和3万元担保获释，以便他清偿索赔。陆提供必要担保后，于昨日下午4时30分获释。随后，陆在其律师陪同下出现在特区民事法庭。
        余长策法官讯问他是否在大光明电影院（Auditorium）和逸园跑狗场（Canidrome）持有股份。
        陆回答说，他与大光明电影院没有关系，但在逸园跑狗场持有1000多股，这些股份已抵押给宁波商业银行以获取4万元贷款。陆声称他的债务总额为90万元，但他人欠他总计100万元，其中他能收回10万元以上。陆补充说，他在宁波商业银行有15万元，这是一笔抵押贷款的收益，他还向中益信托公司（Chung Yih Finance Corporation）垫付了15万元，他的亲属存款总计10万元。仅会有50万元的短缺。他准备暂时清偿剩余索赔额的50%（5万元）。
        余法官命令拘留陆锡侯，以待调查陆锡侯是否确实持有大光明电影院的股份。

pages.en:
THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, SATURDAY, JANUARY 19. 1935

FINANCIER STILL HELD
BY POLICE

Mr S. H. Loh, director of the China
Industrial Bank, Nanking Road, who
was granted bail in the sum of $20,-
000 in cash and $30,000 shop security
by the First District Court's Criminal
Division on Thursday, was ordered
to be detained again by the Court's
Civil Division on the ground that in-
quiries were continuing into the total
amount of his assets and that, if he
were released, it would be impossible
to ascertain the exact amount. Loh
was arrested last year and charged
with frauds, following the closing of
his Bank.

金融家仍被警方拘留

南京路中国实业银行董事陆先生（Mr S. H. Loh）周四被第一特区法院刑事庭准予以2万元现金和3万元铺保保释，但随后被该法院民事庭命令再次拘留，理由是对其资产总额的调查仍在继续，如果将其释放，将无法确定确切金额。陆去年在其银行停业后被捕，并被指控欺诈。

January 18, 1935. Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers :-

THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

Following the closing of the Industrial
Bank of China, the Legal Department of the Shanghai
Municipal Council brought a charge of fraud against
Loh Shih Hou (陸錫侯), the Managing-Director,
Loh Long Hsiang (陸夢翔), the Sub-Manager, and
Sun She Zung (孫賡仁), the Manager of the Sin
Hwa Trading Company (新華貿易公司). The Legal
Department also charged Van Vee Chien (萬維)
and Chow Siao Peng (周少朋), important employees
of the Bank, with failing to keep the accounts in
proper order.
Yesterday, the case was again heard by Judge
Chien Hung Yih (錢鴻翼) in the First Special
District Court. "Tao Ya Sin" (陶亞新), a
British chartered accountant retained by the S.I.I.,
was in attendance. After the Judge had
questioned the chartered accountant on some doubtful
points in connection with the accounts, he interrogated
Loh Shih Hou about the mortgage of property belonging
to Jong Kuc Tse (王國芝).
Of the other accused, only Chow Siao Peng
was present. The Municipal Advocate told the
Judge that the police only desired to continue the
case against those accused in Court and to withdraw
the charge against the others.
Wu Ling Kwen (吳麟坤) and Van Kong (范剛),
the lawyers appearing for Loh Shih Hou, then related
to the Court all the facts in the case after which
Judge Chien, addressing Loh Shih Hou, said, "I have
the power to find you guilty or not guilty. If I
deliver judgment now, you may try to evade a settlement
of the claims; on the other hand, if I judge you not
guilty, again you may refuse to settle the claims.
To preserve the interest of the creditors, I shall
suspend judgment for the time being but will later
render my judgment on the basis of what you have done
to settle the claims."
The Judge then ordered that the case against
Loh Shih Hou, Loh Mong Hsiang and Sun She Zung be
suspended and that Loh Shih Hou be permitted to be
released on bail of $20,000 cash and $30,000 security.
The Judge also ordered that whenever he considered it
necessary for the Court to interfere with the measures
adopted for the liquidation of the bank, he would
make an order to that effect.
The Judge then pronounced Chow Siao Peng, Van
Vee Chien not guilty and dismissed the charge against
Chen Chi Ku (陳季侃), Hang Siang (項馬義), Woo
Lee Hwa (吳理華), Feng Vee Jen (馮未江), Loh
Zai Tseng (羅瑞徵), Wong Chi (王奇), Loh Shih
Van (陸錫藩), and Wong Chi Shi (王紫軒).
