《时报》及其他本地报纸：-

中国实业银行

继中国实业银行停业后，上海公共租界工部局法律处对总经理陆锡侯（Loh Shih Hou）、副经理陆梦翔（Loh Long Hsiang）和新华贸易公司（Sin Hwa Trading Company）经理孙赓仁（Sun She Zung）提出欺诈指控。法律处还指控银行重要职员万维（Van Vee Chien）和周少朋（Chow Siao Peng）未能妥善保持账目有序。
昨日，第一特区地方法院钱鸿翼（Chien Hung Yih）法官再次审理此案。受工部局聘请的英国特许会计师“陶亚新”（Tao Ya Sin）出庭。法官就账目中的一些疑点讯问该特许会计师后，审问了陆锡侯关于王国芝（Jong Kuc Tse）财产抵押的事宜。
其他被告中，只有周少朋出庭。公诉人告诉法官，警方仅希望继续对在庭被告的案件，并撤销对其他人的指控。
随后，代表陆锡侯出庭的律师吴麟坤（Wu Ling Kwen）和范刚（Van Kong）向法庭陈述了案件的所有事实，此后钱法官对陆锡侯说：“我有权判定你有罪或无罪。如果我现在宣判，你可能会试图逃避清偿索赔；另一方面，如果我判你无罪，你可能再次拒绝清偿索赔。为了保护债权人的利益，我将暂时暂缓判决，稍后将根据你为清偿索赔所做的行动作出判决。”
法官随后命令暂停对陆锡侯、陆梦翔和孙赓仁的案件，并准许陆锡侯以2万元现金保释金和3万元担保获释。法官还命令，每当他认为法院有必要干预银行清算所采取的措施时，将就此发出命令。
法官随后宣判周少朋、万维无罪，并驳回对陈季侃（Chen Chi Ku）、项马义（Hang Siang）、吴理华（Woo Lee Hwa）、冯未江（Feng Vee Jen）、罗瑞徵（Loh Zai Tseng）、王奇（Wong Chi）、陆锡藩（Loh Shih Van）和王紫轩（Wong Chi Shi）的指控。

January 6, 1934.                                          Morning Translation

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

LOH SHIH HOU'S PROPERTY DISTRAINED

In connection with the bankruptcy of the
Industrial Bank of China, Loh Shih Hou, Chairman of the
Board of Directors of the Bank, has appeared several
times before the First Special District Court. The
Court has specially appointed a judge to deal with
the liquidation affairs of the bank. At the same time,
Loh Shih Hou has handed in an inventory of his property
to the Court for the purpose of paying off the debts
of the bank. The Court has decided that the property
be distrained.
The Hotel Lieza on Rue Montauban, and the
Dah Chien (大千) World Amusement Resort on Route des
Soeurs, are the property of Loh. With the exception
of a portion of immovable property in the Amusement
Resort which is mortgaged to the Chong Yieh (昌業) Real
Estate Company and others, all property belonging to
Loh in the French Concession was distrained on January 4
on the approval of the Second Special District Court.

罗士豪财产被查封

鉴于中国实业银行破产案，该行董事会主席罗士豪已多次出庭于第一特区地方法院。法院特别指派一名法官处理该行的清算事务。同时，罗士豪已向法院提交其财产清单，旨在偿还银行债务。法院决定查封其财产。
位于蒙托邦路（Rue Montauban）的丽扎酒店（Hotel Lieza），以及位于修女路（Route des Soeurs）的大千世界游乐场，均为罗氏产业。除游乐场中部分不动产已抵押给昌业房地产公司及其他方外，罗氏在法租界内的所有财产均已于1月4日经第二特区地方法院批准予以查封。

Sin Jit Po (Evening Edition) of 4.1.35 :-

ARRIVAL OF CHINESE DEPORTEES FROM JAPAN

A 23rd batch consisting of 12 Chinese
deportees from Japan arrived in Shanghai on December
29, 1934. On arrival they were given 10 each by
the Central Overseas Affairs Committee and are now
staying at the Lao Kung Sing (老公信) Lodging
House, Nantao Bund.
Being destitute they detailed Zung Yuen
Dzi (鄭源地) alias Ah Dzi (阿地) and Yao Yung
Ning (姚永寧) as representatives to proceed to
Nanking, by the 11 p.m. to-night in company with Mr.
Zee Chih Tsaung (徐芝莊), a member of the Nanchow
gentry in Shanghai, to submit petitions to the Central
Kuomintang Headquarters, the Executive Yuan and the
Ministry of Foreign Affairs requesting that they be
immediately sent to work in the Chiao Loh Village in
Anhwei, in order to avoid making them homeless in
Shanghai.

December 30, 1934. Morning translation

Shun Pao and other local newspapers

MEETING OF CREDITORS OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

The Industrial Bank of China has been
closed for more than a month, but no proper measures
to settle the claims have yet been devised.
The various creditors held a conference on
December 16 at which 9 representatives were elected to
consult with the representatives of Loh Shih Hou on
measures for a settlement.
Both parties have agreed to the following
measures:-
1. That Loh Shih Hou pay half of the claims to the
creditors before the end of the year and the other
half to be paid by him later.
2. That the creditors support an application for Loh
Shih hou's release on bail.
The representatives of the creditors called
a second meeting at 2 p.m. yesterday at the Chamber of
Commerce to submit a report on the negotiations. The
above resolutions were adopted. The representatives
were authorized to arrange matters.

中国实业银行债权人会议

中国实业银行已停业一个多月，但尚未制定出妥善的偿债措施。
各债权人于12月16日举行会议，选举出9名代表，就偿债措施与罗士豪的代表进行磋商。
双方已同意以下措施：-
1. 罗士豪须在年底前向债权人支付一半债款，另一半由其日后支付。

债权人代表于昨日下午2时在商会召开第二次会议，提交谈判报告。上述决议获通过。代表们获授权处理相关事宜。

December 28, 1934.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

The case of the Industrial Bank of China cannot be settled yet, because the assets of the Bank are insufficient to meet the liabilities. Loh Shih Hou (陸士侯), the Managing-Director, is still being detained by the Court. Recently Loh expressed his willingness to satisfy all claims out of his private property and has asked Yu Yi Ching to act as security for his release.
The creditors of the Bank held a meeting on December 16 at which representatives were appointed to negotiate with the Bank for a settlement of their claims. They will hold another meeting at 2 p.m. December 28 at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, North Soochow Road. It is learned that a compromise has been reached with the Bank.

China Times and other local newspapers:

ESCAPE OF A CONVICTED MURDERER

At 7.20 a.m. yesterday a prisoner named Chen Ching Lan (陳金蘭), serving a sentence of 12 years' imprisonment for murder, made his escape from the Detention House of the Second Special District Court. The Court authorities have been informed and the six warders responsible have been detained.

On the evening of December 25, about eight or nine loafers accompanied by three women came to Chen Ah Tseng's home and declared that Hu Kwei Pao was the wife of one of their comrades. Eventually Chen Ah Tseng and the loafers went to Yulin Road Police Station. The police interpreter asked Hu Kwei Pao who was her husband. She replied that Chen Ah Tseng was her husband, whereupon the interpreter rebuked her for telling a lie and allowed the loafers to take her away.

To propagate the victory of the bandit
suppression campaign, the Shanghai City Government will
hold a "Broadcasting meeting to Celebrate Bandit
Suppression Victory" at the Broadcasting Station of the
Great China Dispensary on Foochow Road on January 3, 1935.
Speeches and songs will be broadcasted from 8 a.m. to
1 p.m. on that day.
Mayor Wu Te Chen, General Yang Hu, Chief
of the Peace Preservation Corps, Mr. O.K.Yue, Chief
Secretary of the Shanghai City Government, Mr. Ian Kung
Chan, Chief of the Education Bureau, Messrs. Wang Hsiao
Lai, Chu Min Yi, and Yu Yah Ching will be among the
speakers.

Eastern Times and other local newspapers:

HONGKONG & SHANGHAI BANK REFUTES RUMOURS OF IMPORTATION
OF $20,000,000 TO SHANGHAI

A newspaper reporter had an interview with
the Chief of the Remittance Department of the Hongkong
& Shanghai Banking Corporation to question him in regard
to a report that the Bank had imported $20,000,000 cash
from Hongkong.
The bank official stated that the report
was untrue and that he had no knowledge as to whether
the Ministry of Finance had made such a suggestion. If
it is desired to import silver, it might be possible to
secure the return of silver that had already been exported.

December 18, 1934. Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

A report was published in the newspapers yesterday to the effect that the creditors of the Industrial Bank of China held a meeting on December 16 at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, at which a resolution was passed that Hsu Sing Ich, a member of the Shanghai Municipal Council, and other leading residents be asked to mediate.

A reporter secured an interview with Mr. Hsu yesterday. Mr. Hsu stated that he had not been asked to mediate and that he knew nothing about the matter.

Yesterday, the lawyers retained by Loh Shih Hou, the Managing Director of the Industrial Bank of China, sent the following letter to this paper:-

"Your paper published an article to-day, stating that at a meeting of the creditors of the Industrial Bank of China, the lawyers of Loh Shih Hou informed those present that the deficit of about $200,000 would be made good by disposing of the property of the Bank and of Loh Shih Hou who has agreed to settle all claims.

"We would inform you that the report is incorrect, because the statement we made on behalf of Loh Shih Hou was to the effect that the deficit of about $200,000 would be made good by disposing of the property of the Bank, while Loh Shih Hou will liquidate the claims.

"We shall be obliged if you will publish this correction."

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE WIN. (N) FINANCE COMPANY

The Win. (N) Finance Company on North Szechuen Road and its branch on Avenue Joffre on December 11 announced a suspension of business for one week. So far the Company is still closed.

Yesterday, a reporter secured information to the effect that a notice written on ordinary letter paper and without signature or chop has been posted in front of the Company stating that it had at first been planned to re-open the Company on December 19, but owing to the absconding of the General-Manager, the accounts of the Company have to be audited for which purpose, Lawyers Eugene Kiang (江一平), Sun Chi Chong (孫基昌) and Wu Kai Seng (吳凱聲), and Chartered Accountant Kiang Yan Ping (江彥平) have been retained. As soon as the accounts have been audited, a notice of the reopening of the Company will be published.

中国实业银行

昨日各报刊登一则消息，称中国实业银行债权人于12月16日在上海总商会举行会议，通过决议，请求上海公共租界工部局董事许信义（Hsu Sing Ich）及其他地方闻人出面调解。

一名记者昨日采访了许先生。许先生表示，他并未受邀进行调解，且对此事一无所知。

昨日，中国实业银行总经理罗士厚（Loh Shih Hou）所聘律师向本报致函如下：

“贵报今日刊登一篇文章，称在中国实业银行债权人会议上，罗士厚的律师告知与会者，约20万元的亏空将通过处置银行及罗士厚的财产来弥补，罗士厚已同意清偿所有债务。

“特此告知，该报道不实，因为我们代表罗士厚所作的声明大意是：约20万元的亏空将通过处置银行财产来弥补，而罗士厚将负责清理债务。

“如蒙刊登此更正启事，不胜感激。”

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:- MORNING TRANSLATION 30/12/34

MEETING OF CREDITORS OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

The Industrial Bank of China has been
closed for more than a month, but no proper measures
to settle the claims have yet been devised.
The various creditors held a conference on
December 16 at which 9 representatives were elected to
consult with the representatives of Loh Shih Hou on
measures for a settlement.
Both parties have agreed to the following
measures:-
1. That Loh Shih Hou pay half of the claims to the
creditors before the end of the year and the other
half to be paid by him later.
2. That the creditors support an application for Loh
Shih Hou's release on bail.
The representatives of the creditors called
a second meeting at 2 p.m. yesterday at the Chamber of
Commerce to submit a report on the negotiations. The
above resolutions were adopted. The representatives
were authorized to arrange matters.

中国实业银行债权人会议

中国实业银行已关闭一个多月，但尚未制定出妥善的偿债措施。
各位债权人于12月16日举行会议，选举出9名代表，与罗士厚的代表就和解措施进行磋商。

1. 罗士厚在年底前向债权人支付一半的债款，另一半由他日后支付。

Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

The case of the Industrial Bank of China
cannot be settled yet, because the assets of the Bank
are insufficient to meet the liabilities. Loh Shih Hou
(陸壽侯), the Managing-Director, is still being
detained by the Court. Recently Loh expressed his
willingness to satisfy all claims out of his private
property and has asked Yu Ya Ching to act as security
for his release.
The creditors of the Bank held a meeting
on December 16 at which representatives were appointed
to negotiate with the Bank for a settlement of their
claims. They will hold another meeting at 2 p.m.
December 28 at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, North
Soochow Road. It is learned that a compromise has been
reached with the Bank.

Shanghai Morning Post (Evening Edition):
THE CLOSING OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

The First Shanghai Special District Court
has held several hearings of the case relating to the
closing of the Industrial Bank of China, and Loh Shih
Hou has expressed a desire to settle his liabilities
out of his private property; he has handed his title
deeds to the Court.
Information from local bankers reveals that
the creditors of the Industrial Bank have asked
Messrs Yu Ya Ching (虞洽卿), Feng Ping Nan (馮炳南)
and other local prominent merchants to mediate for a
settlement of the case. It is reported that a certain
plan has been drawn up after a discussion between
Messrs Yu and Feng and the representatives of Loh Shih
Hou. The plan will be carried out as soon as Loh Shih
Hou has been released on bail.

《上海泰晤士报》（晚刊）：
中国实业银行的关闭

上海第一特区地方法院已就中国实业银行关闭案进行了数次听证，罗士厚表示愿以私人财产清偿债务；他已将地契移交法院。
据本地银行界人士透露，中国实业银行的债权人已请求虞洽卿、冯炳南及其他本地著名商人出面调解，以解决此案。据报道，虞、冯二人与罗士厚的代表讨论后，已拟定某项计划。一旦罗士厚获准保释，该计划即予实施。

December 21, 1944.                          Afternoon Translation.

THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

The following advertisement is published in the
Sin Wen Pao and other local newspapers by the Industrial
Bank of China Creditors Group:-
"This Creditors Group held a meeting on
December 16 at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce to
discuss measures to settle their claims. Questions
were put to lawyer Wu Ling Kwen (吳靈坤), representing
Loh Shih Hou (羅士厚) as to whether Loh has the
intention to satisfy the claims of the creditors.
Lawyer Wu then submitted a compromise proposal whereby
Loh Shih Hou will undertake to pay out half of the
amount of the claims within this year (old calendar)
and to clear off the balance as early as possible. The
meeting accepted the proposal and appointed Loo Kin
Hong (盧建康), Tang Ling Sue (唐凌蘇), Tung Yu
(董瑜), Wong Shu Ar (黃樹亞), Ou Pang (歐鵬),
Chien Tseng Ling (錢增齡), Yuen Chi Liang (阮志良),
Yao Kin Chee (姚建基) and Chu Ya Kwei (朱亞桂), as
representatives to negotiate for a settlement of their
claims.
"The meeting also resolved that the office of
Lawyer Tung Yu on the first floor of No.89 Foochow Road
be used as a temporary office of the Creditors Group.
"The end of the year (old calendar) is fast
approaching. The claims must be settled as soon as possible.
All creditors are hereby notified to call with necessary
documents at this temporary office and to register their
claims in order to enable this Group to proceed with the
case."

中国实业银行债权人团在《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下广告：
“本债权人团于12月16日在上海总商会举行会议，讨论清偿债务的措施。会上向代表罗士厚（羅士厚）的律师吴灵坤（吳靈坤）提问，询问罗氏是否有意清偿债权人债务。吴律师随后提交了一份和解提案， whereby 罗士厚承诺在年内（农历）支付一半债款，并尽早还清余款。会议接受了该提案，并推选卢建康（盧建康）、唐凌苏（唐凌蘇）、董瑜（董瑜）、黄树亚（黃樹亞）、欧鹏（歐鵬）、钱增龄（錢增齡）、阮志良（阮志良）、姚建基（姚建基）和朱亚桂（朱亞桂）为代表，就债务清偿问题进行谈判。
“会议还决议，将福州路89号一楼董瑜律师办事处作为债权人团的临时办公处。
“年终（农历）将至。必须尽快清偿债务。特此通知全体债权人携带必要文件前往该临时办公处登记债权，以便本团推进此案。”

December 17, 1934. Morning Translation.
China Times and other local newspapers:

THE CREDITORS OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

The creditors of the Industrial Bank of China held a meeting at the Chamber of Commerce yesterday. Luo Ka Heng(羅家衡) and six other lawyers representing the Creditors Group together with Chien Chun Lin(錢春林) and 300 other creditors were present. Lawyer Wu Ling Kung(吳麟坤), Loh Shih Hou's attorney, was also in attendance.

The meeting opened at 3 p.m. when Luo Ka Heng, Chien Chun Lin and Wo Peng(郭鵬) were elected as chairmen. Loh Shih Hou's attorney then explained his client's relations with the bank and stated that Loh was willing to put up $200,000 cash at the end of the Chinese new year to satisfy the creditors. The balance of $200,000 would be repaid by converting the property of the Industrial Bank of China into cash. But all this could only be done if Loh was released on bail.

Lawyer Tung Yu(董俞) approved Lawyer Wu Ling Kung's proposal for an amicable settlement and suggested that substantial guarantees be given. He then reported on the mediation by Messrs. Yu Yah Ching(虞洽卿), Ling Keng Hou(林庚侯), Wen Lan Ting(聞蘭亭), Hsu Sin Loh(徐新六), and Feng Bin Nan(馮炳南).

Nine persons including Tang Lin Shih(唐鳴時), Luo Ka Heng, Chu Yia Kui(朱亞奎), Chien Chun Lin, Yao Ka Ling(姚嘉齡), Wo Peng, Wang Shou An(王守安), Tung Yu etc. were elected as representatives of the creditors to draw up an amicable settlement after which a date will be fixed for a meeting of all creditors.

The Social Evening News:-

MEMORIAL SERVICE FOR PAN HUNG SENG POSTPONED

After the death of Pan Hung Seng(潘洪生), the Patriots Support Committee established at the Chamber of Commerce decided to hold a memorial meeting. The Committee requested the Chamber for permission to hold the meeting in the auditorium of the Chamber, but the request was rejected on the ground that the auditorium had never been used for such a purpose before.

As the Chamber had permitted the memorial service for the late Sze Liang Zai to be held in its auditorium, the Patriots Support Committee sent a letter on the morning of December 16 to the chairman of the Chamber repeating its request for permission to use the auditorium. Pending a reply from the Chamber, the service will be postponed.

潘洪生追悼会延期

潘洪生（潘洪生）去世后，设在总商会的爱国支援委员会决定举行追悼会。该委员会请求总商会批准在总商会礼堂举行会议，但该请求以礼堂此前从未用于此类用途为由被拒绝。

鉴于总商会曾允许在礼堂举行施良宰先生的追悼会，爱国支援委员会于12月16日上午致函总商会主席，再次请求批准使用礼堂。在等待总商会回复期间，追悼会将延期举行。

December 16, 1934. Morning Translation.

China Evening News:
THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA TO BE FORMALLY LIQUIDATED

With reference to the affairs of the Industrial Bank of China, Judge Chien Hung Yih (錢鴻業) has ascertained that after the Bank's assets have been distributed, there will still be a deficit of about $400,000. He has appointed Judge Yu Chang Tse (余長資) as liquidator of the Bank. Loh Shih Hou (羅士侯), the Managing-Director of the Bank, who was taken into custody by Police upon the collapse of the Bank, has expressed his willingness to satisfy all the claims of creditors out of his private property.

Yesterday Judge Yu Chang Tse issued the following notice for the liquidation of the Bank:-
"Loh Shih Hou has applied for permission to liquidate the Industrial Bank of China. In accordance with paragraph 1 of Article 16 of the law relating to the liquidation of business concerns, this Court has attached all the property belonging to the applicant.
"Notice is hereby given that all transfers and other methods of disposal of his property, which has already been attached by this Court, will be null and void."

Judge Yu has ordered Loh Shih Hou to be detained pending a settlement of the case.

After the closing of the Industrial Bank of China, Chang Kai Chee (張開池) and other depositors of the Bank, represented by Wong Bei Yuan and other lawyers, filed a claim for the return of about $40,000 and requested the attachment of the office of the Bank on Nanking Road. Chun Wen Boh (陳文波) and other creditors of the Bank have secured legal assistance to claim the return of their money.

Now that the Court has ordered the Bank to be liquidated and Loh Shih Hou has expressed his willingness to satisfy the claims of the creditors, with Yu Ya Ching agreeing to mediate, the lawyers retained by Chun, Wen Boh and others have joined the lawyers of Chang Kai Chee and other creditors and will hold a meeting to-morrow at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce to discuss a solution to the case.

Lawyer Lu Kya Heng (羅嘉衡) and seven other lawyers publish a notice in the advertisement columns of the Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers on behalf of the creditors of the Industrial Bank of China, stating that a meeting of creditors will be held at 2 p.m. December 16 at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, North Soochow Road, and urging all creditors to attend the meeting.

1934年12月16日。晨间译件。

《中国晚报》：
中国实业银行将正式清算

关于中国实业银行一案，钱鸿业法官查明，在该行资产分配后，仍将出现约40万元的赤字。他已任命余长资法官为该行的清算人。该行总经理罗士侯在银行倒闭时被警方拘留，他表示愿意以个人财产清偿所有债权人的索赔。

昨日，余长资法官发布了关于该银行清算的如下公告：
“罗士侯已申请获准清算中国实业银行。根据《商业机构清算法》第十六条第一款之规定，本庭已查封属于申请人的所有财产。
特此公告，凡转移及以其他方式处置其已被本庭查封之财产者，均属无效。”

余法官已命令将罗士侯羁押，以待案件解决。

中国实业银行停业后，张开池及其他存款人在黄佩元等律师的代表下，提出索赔约4万元，并请求查封位于南京路的银行办事处。陈文波及该行的其他债权人也已寻求法律协助，要求追回款项。

鉴于法院已下令对该行进行清算，且罗士侯表示愿意清偿债权人债务，虞洽卿同意从中调解，陈文波等人聘请的律师已与张开池及其他债权人的律师联合，将于明日在上海总商会举行会议，商讨本案的解决方案。

律师罗嘉衡及其他七名律师代表中国实业银行的债权人，在《新闻报》及其他本地报纸的广告栏刊登公告，称债权人会议将于12月16日下午2时在苏州路北路的上海总商会举行，并敦促所有债权人出席会议。

THE CREDITORS OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

Lawyers Tang Pei Yuan, (任培源), Luo Ka Heng
(羅家衡), Dong Min Shih(董鳴時), Dung Yu(董俞), Wang
Shou An(汪壽安), Chu Yia Kwei(朱亞桂), and Chen Tseng
Ping(陳正平) publish the following notice in the

newspapers calling a conference of creditors of the
Industrial Bank of China:-
"According to Kung Wen Fok(龔文福), Chang

律师任培源、罗家衡、董鸣时、董俞、汪寿安、朱亚桂和陈正平在《申报》及其他本地报纸的广告栏刊登如下公告，召集中国实业银行债权人会议：
“据中国实业银行债权人龔文福、張開記和龔婉記称，包括该行董事会主席罗士侯在内的该行代表已向法庭申请获准清算该行。目前尚不清楚该请求是否已获批准。由于此事与债权人利益密切相关，且因农历年底临近，若案件不能迅速解决，债权人将受到严重影响。所有债权人应首先组织成立债权人团体，并选举负责任的代表随时处理此案。特此通知，所有债权人会议将于12月16日下午2时在总商会举行。望各位债权人携带债权凭证出席会议。”

December 7, 1934. Morning translation

China Times and other local newspapers.

THE AFFAIRS OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

It is learned that, with the exception of certain
papers and books still in the custody of the Police, the
accounts, bills, etc. kept in the Administration Office of
the Industrial Bank of China have been investigated by
auditor Hsu Yung Cho (徐永祚).

The audit shows that the Commercial Department
has liabilities amounting to $449,303.34 and assets $563,862.62
while the Savings Department has liabilities to talling
$498,151.75 and assets $74,640.47.

The combined accounts of the Commercial Department and
the Savings Department shows a deficit of about $308,500. Of this
amount, $74,986.29 was spent for the construction of the
office on Nanking Road and the offices on Rue Montauban,
Avenue Foch, and at Soochow. The accounts relating to
the balance of the deficit cannot be checked because the
books are in the hands of the Police.

The Court will order the Police to hand over
to the Court all the account books of the Administration
office. They will be handed to the auditor for
examination.

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸。

中国实业银行事务

据悉，除仍由警方保管的某些文件和账簿外，存于中国实业银行行政办公室的账目、票据等已由审计师徐永祚进行调查。

审计显示，商业部负债额为449,303.34美元，资产为563,862.62美元；而储蓄部负债总额为498,151.75美元，资产为74,640.47美元。

商业部和储蓄部的合并账目显示赤字约为308,500美元。其中，74,986.29美元用于建造南京路办事处以及蒙托邦路（Rue Montauban）、福煦路（Avenue Foch）和苏州的办事处。有关剩余赤字的账目无法核对，因为账簿仍在警方手中。

法院将命令警方将行政办公室的所有账簿移交给法院。这些账簿将移交给审计师进行检查。

December 6, 1934.
Morning Translation.

Chen Tao and other local newspapers:

LOH SHIH HOU WILLING TO SELL PRIVATE PROPERTY TO SETTLE
LIABILITIES OF INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA- TITLE DEEDS
AND MORTGAGE DOCUMENTS PRESENTED- HUPEH PROVINCIAL
GOVERNMENT OWES THE BANK $600,000.

A further hearing of the case of the Industrial
Bank of China was held yesterday afternoon by Judge
Chier Hung Yih, President of the Criminal Court of the
1st Special District Court. Most of the bank's
creditors were in attendance.
Mr. Paul Au, Assistant Municipal Advocate of
the Municipal Police, stated that the Judge of the
Criminal Court had called personally at the Ningpo
Commercial Bank on November 20 to make an investigation
into the matter of the mortgaging of the title deeds
by the Industrial Bank of China with the Ningpo Bank.
The Municipal Advocate added that a reply had been
received from the Ningpo Bank for purposes of record.
Addressing Loh Shih Hou (陸錫侯), Judge Chien
said:- "The Industrial Bank of China mortgaged four
title deeds to the Ningpo Commercial Bank on October
25, 1933 for $270,000. These title deeds were
mortgaged by your wife Wong Kuo Tse (王國芝) with the
Savings Department of the Industrial Bank for $70,000
on October 24, 1933. According to your statement, the names
on the title deeds must be altered. The Court has
made an investigation into the matter with the firm of
Brandt & Rodgers and Algar & Company, in whose names
these title deeds had been registered and learned that
the name on the title deed registered in the name of
Brandt & Rodgers had been replaced with that of the
Ningpo Commercial Bank on October 21, 1933 and that the
names on the three title deeds registered in the name
of Algar & Company had likewise been altered and replaced
by the name of the Ningpo Commercial Bank on October 23.
These two dates of mortgaging the title deeds were before
the date, according to your statement, on which Wong Kuo
Tse had mortgaged the title deeds with the Industrial
Bank of China. Either the title deeds had been used in two
different ways or the mortgage of the deeds with the
Industrial Bank was one in name only."
Loh Shih Hou stated that the title deeds had
been borrowed from his wife by the Industrial Bank of China
and the bank had mortgaged them with the Ningpo
Commercial Bank. Loh added that he could not remember
the date on which the deeds were mortgaged with the
Ningpo Bank.
The Court questioned the accused Sung Shu Jen
(孫樹仁) about the statement made by Zing Bo Yih (秦抱一)
to the Police to the effect that following the bankruptcy
of the Industrial Bank of China, Sung frequently went
to the bank to hold meetings and asked what were the
matters discussed at the meetings.
Sung She Jen denied any knowledge of this matter,
while Loh Meng Shiang (陸夢翔), another accused, stated
that he had seen Sung She Jen visiting the Industrial

1934年12月6日。
晨间译件。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

罗士侯愿变卖私产以清偿中国实业银行债务——呈交地契及抵押文件——湖北省政府欠该行60万美元。

第一特区地方法院刑事庭庭长钱鸿业法官昨日下午再次审理中国实业银行一案。该行大多数债权人出席了庭审。
市政警察助理公诉人保罗·欧先生陈述，刑事庭法官曾于11月20日亲自前往宁波商业银行，调查中国实业银行向宁波银行抵押地契一事。这位助理公诉人补充说，已收到宁波银行的回复以备记录。
钱法官对罗锡侯说道：“中国实业银行于1933年10月25日向宁波商业银行抵押了四张地契，金额为27万元。这些地契是由你的妻子王国芝于1933年10月24日以中国实业银行储蓄部的名义抵押了7万元。根据你的陈述，地契上的名字必须更改。本庭已向布兰特与罗杰斯公司（Brandt & Rodgers）及阿尔加公司（Algar & Company）进行了调查，这些地契是以这两家公司的名义注册的，经查得，注册在布兰特与罗杰斯公司名下的地契，其名字已于1933年10月21日被替换为宁波商业银行的名字；同样，注册在阿尔加公司名下的三张地契，其名字也于10月23日被更改并替换为宁波商业银行的名字。这两个抵押地契的日期，均早于你所说的王国芝将地契抵押给中国实业银行的日期。要么这些地契被用于两种不同的用途，要么向中国银行抵押地契只是名义上的。”
罗士侯陈述称，地契是被中国实业银行从其妻子处借走的，随后银行将其抵押给了宁波商业银行。罗补充说，他不记得向宁波银行抵押地契的具体日期。
法庭就秦抱一向警方所作的陈述讯问了被告孙树仁，该陈述称在中国实业银行破产后，孙经常去银行开会，并询问会议上讨论了什么事项。
孙树仁否认知晓此事，而另一名被告陆梦翔则陈述称，他曾看到孙树仁访问中国实业

December 6, 1934. Morning Translation.

Bank of China on one occasion and that he had no connection with the transactions in artificial silk.
Judge Chien Hung Yih, addressing Loh Shih Hcu, said that according to the audit, the Savings Department of the Industrial Bank of China owed $560,000 and that the Court had sent a Judge to handle the liquidation.
Wu Ling Kwan (吳靈關), Loh Shih Hcu's lawyer, replied:- "The Savings Department is in debt to the amount of some $500,000, but of this sum $100,000 belonged to the relatives of Lch. Therefore Loh is only in debt to outsiders for only $300,000. Loh is determined to sell his private property to clear his debts, and certain prominent local merchants including Mr. Yu Ya Ching are prepared to be guarantors for Lch's release in order to enable him to deal with the matter more quickly. A request has been made for the release of Loh on bail."
Judge Chien then said, "The business department still owes $400,000. As you have decided to use your private property to clear off the liabilities, you should draw up a list of your property as soon as possible, and make a request that a Judge be appointed to handle the settlement of accounts. The criminal prosecution will be temporarily postponed. But your application for bail cannot be granted at present because it has not yet been established whether you are guilty or not guilty of the criminal charges filed against you. This Court will deal with this case with absolute impartiality, and it will not be necessary for you to ask any person to speak in your behalf. You should understand that the President of this Court will deal with the case according to law, and no amount of pleading will be of any benefit to you. I am afraid that your family is being imposed upon by some person, so it would be better for you to give them some advice."
At the close of his address, Judge Chien withdrew from the Court.

Judge Yu Chang Tzo (余長佐), of the Civil Court, then took his seat on the bench. He asked Loh Shih Hcu, who had stated that he was willing to settle all the liabilities of the bank, to draw up a list of his property, and another list showing the total amount of his liabilities in accordance with the liquidation regulations.
Loh Shih Hou stated that this could not be done because all the account books etc. had been detained by the Police.
Judge Yu replied that the Court would secure them from the Police. He then asked what was the amount of the liabilities.
Loh Shih Hou replied: "The liabilities amount to about $940,000 but the Hupeh Provincial Government owes the bank a sum of $600,000 and although the Government has been repeatedly requested to repay the money, not a
pages.zh:
3
1934年12月6日。晨间译文。

与中国银行有一次往来，且他与人造丝交易无关。

钱鸿业法官对陆士豪说，根据审计，中国实业银行储蓄部欠款56万美元，法院已派出一名法官处理清算事宜。

陆士豪的律师吴灵关（吳靈關）回答说：“储蓄部债务约为50万美元，但这笔款项中有10万美元属于陆的亲属。因此，陆对外部人员的债务仅为30万美元。陆决心变卖其私人财产以清偿债务，包括虞洽卿先生在内的某些当地知名商人准备为陆的获释提供担保，以便他能更迅速地处理此事。现申请将陆保释。”

钱法官随后说：“营业部仍欠款40万美元。既然你决定用私人财产清偿债务，应尽快列出你的财产清单，并请求指派一名法官来处理账目结算。刑事起诉将暂时推迟。但由于尚未确定你对被提起的刑事指控是有罪还是无罪，目前不能批准你的保释申请。本庭将绝对公正地处理此案，你无需请任何人为你说情。你应该明白，本院院长将依法处理此案，无论多少求情都对你无益。我担心你的家人正受到某人的蒙骗，所以你最好给他们一些建议。”

钱法官发言结束后退庭。

民事法庭法官余长佐（余長佐）随后入座。他要求曾表示愿意清偿银行所有债务的陆士豪，按照清算规定编制一份财产清单，以及一份显示其负债总额的清单。

陆士侯表示这无法做到，因为所有账簿等物均被警方扣押。

余法官回答说，法院将从警方处获取这些物品。他随后询问负债金额是多少。

陆士侯回答说：“负债总额约为94万美元，但湖北省政府欠银行60万美元，虽然多次要求政府还款，但银行分文未收，尽管已告知政府这笔钱是储蓄存款保证金的一部分。”陆士侯进一步指出，在94万美元的负债中，有超过10万美元属于他的亲友，这些债权人愿意将存折和收据送交法院保管，并同意最后获得退款。此外，银行还有价值超过20万美元的财产，如果这仍不足够，他将用私人财产偿还债务。

陆士侯随后向法庭提交了属于其亲友的银行存折和收据，以及其私人财产的契据和抵押收据，以证明其所言属实。

律师吴林坤在此重申了陆的保释申请，称如果陆未被拘留，小储户早已得到偿付，因为在银行关闭时，陆手中有20万美元可用于偿付这些小储户。

法官回答说，保释问题必须由刑事法庭决定。法官随后指令将陆士侯还押拘留，但按原保释条件释放了陆莲香。案件随后再次延期审理。

THE INTERNATIONAL TROTTING CLUB

The inauguration of the International Trotting Club has been prohibited by the Shanghai City Government but we learn that gambling and racing are being conducted by the Club.

In this connection, the local Tangpu has sent the following letter to the Shanghai City Government:-

"This Tangpu has received a petition from the 13th Branch Tangpu, through the 3rd District Tangpu, to the effect that the International Trotting Club is still conducting race meetings despite the order issued by the Shanghai City Government prohibiting its inauguration. The petition suggests that the Shanghai City Government be requested, through the local Tangpu, to make an investigation into the matter.

"At the 97th meeting of the Standing Committee of the 3rd District Tangpu, it was resolved that the petition be transmitted to the Executive Committee of the local Tangpu with a suggestion that the City Government be requested to conduct an investigation."

国际慢步赛马会

上海市政府已禁止国际慢步赛马会成立，但我们获悉该会仍在进行赌博和赛马活动。

就此，本地区坊联会致函上海市政府如下：

“本坊联会通过第三区区坊联会收到第十三分支坊联会的请愿书，称尽管上海市政府已发布命令禁止国际慢步赛马会成立，但该会仍在举行赛马集会。请愿书建议通过本地坊联会请求上海市政府对此事进行调查。

November 29, 1934.
Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE CLOSING OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA : COURT
PROCEEDINGS

In connection with the closing of the Industrial
Bank of China, auditor Zee Yung Chau (徐永祚) was
appointed by the First Special District Court to examine
the accounts of the bank. He has completed the audit
and a report has been sent to the Court.
Mr. Paul Ru, Assistant Municipal Advocate,
who is in charge of the case, has brought further charges
against Loh Shih Hou (陸士豪), Loh Meng Shiang (陸夢湘),
Chen Chi Kan (陳季侃), Hong Siang (洪翔) and Wu
Lee Hwa (吳禮華), the responsible officials of the
bank. The first charge deals with the non-payment
of cheques, cash orders and deposits, which constitutes
fraud and embezzlement for which Loh Shih Hou and Loh
Meng Shiang are responsible. The other charge deals
with violations of the Banking Law, and the Company
Ordinance, for which Chen Chi Kan, Chairman of the
Board of Directors, Loh Shih Hou, Hong Siang and Wu
Lee Hwa, members of the Standing Committee, are held
responsible. The accused had failed to register the
bank with the government authorities or to submit a
report on the business of the bank for purpose of record
or to apply for a licence from the Ministry of Finance
to open a savings department and had conducted business
other than that allowed by the Company Ordinance. They
had thus violated Items 1 and 8 of Article 231 and
Item 4 of Article 233 of the Company Ordinance and
Article 16 of the Savings Bank Law.

The First Special District Court held a hearing
at 2 p.m. yesterday. The accused Loh Shih Hou, Loh Meng
Shiang and Sun Shi Jen (孫世仁) were brought into the
Court by detectives. The accused Van Ve Chien (范偉倩)
and Wu Lee Hwa were summoned to the Court. Wong Yi
She (黃義社), Wang Chi (王奇), Chow Hsao Peng (周少鵬),
Loh Jui Tseng (陸瑞徵), Feng Ve Chin (馮維珍), Hong Siang,
Chen Chi Kan (陳季侃), and Loh Shih Keng (陸士鏗) were not
present.

Mr. Paul Ru, the municipal advocate, stated
that the charges against Loh Shih Hou and Loh Meng Shiang
had to do with fraud and embezzlement.
The first charge deals with the non-payment of
a cash order to the Mitsui Bussan Kaisha. The second
charge is against Loh Shih Hou for employing fraudulent
methods to secure money from depositors.
The third charge deals with the non-payment of
the deposits of the "Shun Pao".
The fourth charge deals with the non-payment of
the deposits with interest of Chien Tseng Min (錢增民).
The fifth charge deals with the refusal of the
Bank to pay the cheque drawn by Lieu Hsao Chai (劉少齋) with-
drawing his deposits from the Bank.
The sixth charge deals with the refusal of the
Bank to honour an order for $4,000 issued to a person named
Pan (潘).

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

中国实业银行停业：法庭诉讼

关于中国实业银行停业一事，第一特区地方法院委任审计师徐永祚（Zee Yung Chau）审查该银行账目。他已完成审计，并向法院提交了报告。

负责此案的助理市检察官保罗·鲁（Paul Ru）对该行负责人陆士豪（陸士豪）、陆梦湘（陸夢湘）、陈季侃（陳季侃）、洪翔（Hong Siang）和吴礼华（吳禮華）提出了进一步指控。第一项指控涉及不支付支票、现金凭单和存款，构成欺诈和挪用公款，由陆士豪和陆梦湘负责。另一项指控涉及违反《银行法》和《公司条例》，由董事会主席陈季侃、常务委员会成员陆士豪、洪翔和吴礼华负责。被告未能向政府当局注册银行，或未提交业务报告以备存档，也未向财政部申请开设储蓄部的许可证，并开展了《公司条例》允许范围之外的业务。他们 thus 违反了《公司条例》第231条第1款和第8款、第233条第4款以及《储蓄银行法》第16条。

第一特区地方法院于昨日下午2时开庭审理。被告陆士豪、陆梦湘和孙世仁（孫世仁）由侦探带至法庭。被告范伟倩（Van Ve Chien）和吴礼华被传唤到庭。黄义社（Wong Yi She）、王奇（Wang Chi）、周少鹏（Chow Hsao Peng）、陆瑞徵（Loh Jui Tseng）、冯维珍（Feng Ve Chin）、洪翔、陈季侃（陳季侃）和陆士铿（Loh Shih Keng）未出庭。

市检察官保罗·鲁表示，对陆士豪和陆梦湘的指控涉及欺诈和挪用公款。

第一项指控涉及未向三井物产株式会社（Mitsui Bussan Kaisha）支付现金凭单。第二项指控针对陆士豪使用欺诈手段从储户处获取资金。

第三项指控涉及未支付《申报》的存款。

第四项指控涉及未支付钱增民（Chien Tseng Min）的带息存款。

第五项指控涉及银行拒绝支付刘少斋（Lieu Hsao Chai）提取其在银行存款所开具的支票。

第六项指控涉及银行拒绝兑现开给一位姓潘（Pan）的人士的4,000美元凭单。

The bankruptcy of the Bank victimized many people. It is impossible for the Court to deal with the cases one by one. The above-mentioned charges are sufficient to include all the cases brought by the creditors.
Municipal advocate Paul Ru stated that the accused had tried every means to avoid payments of money due under one pretext or another, and had recklessly issued cash orders when they knew that the Bank was about to be closed soon. This was a deliberate fraud to deprive people of their money and cannot be regarded as an ordinary business failure.
Chien Hung Yieh (錢鴻業), president of the Criminal Court, interrogated Loh Meng Shiang and Loh Shih Hou about all the charges, except the first charge.
In reply, Loh Meng Shiang stated that the cheque of the "Chun Ho" was at first improperly chopped, Negotiations were opened, and the cheque was changed into a cash order. The order was issued after banking hours and therefore payment could not be made; on the following day, the Bank closed its doors. As to Chien Tseng Lin's desire to withdraw his deposit, the payment was postponed owing to incomplete procedure. As regards the non-payment of Lieu Hsao Chan's cheque, Loh Meng Shiang declared that he had no knowledge of the matter. As to the $4,000 cash order, Loh Shih Hou had been informed prior to the issuing of the order, that the money was to be used for the maintenance of the Bank.
Loh Shih Hou here stated that he had no knowledge of the matter prior to the issuing of the order. He said he was only a member of the Standing Committee of the Chun Yi Banking Syndicate (春益銀團). The branches of the Bank at Soochow, Nantao, and the Western District of Shanghai were established when the Bank was under Kuo Hung Ern (郭宏仁) but he (Loh) was not then a member of the Standing Committee.
Auditor Zee stated that he had not seen any account books of the Administrative Office of the bank.
Loh Sih Hou was then asked whether there were any account books in the Administrative Office.
Lawyers Woo Kung Ling and Van Kong, representing the accused, both stated that the Administrative Office had no account books but there were files of reports from the branches of the Bank but these had been sealed up by the Police.
President Chien questioned accused Loh Sih Hou about the connection between the bank and the International Trotting Club and the mortgage of Wong Kuo Tse's (王國資) title deeds.
Loh Sih Hou said :- "Wong is my wife. In October last year, the bank was in need of funds. Wong then mortgaged four title deeds for $70,000 with the Business Department of the bank. This sum was later deposited with the Savings Department of the bank. I do not know what interest the Savings Department paid, but the interest was fair. Subsequently the bank mortgaged the four title deeds to the Ningpo Commercial Bank for a loan of $500,000."

1934年11月29日。晨间译文。

银行的破产使许多人受害。法院不可能逐一处理这些案件。上述指控足以涵盖债权人提出的所有案件。

市检察官保罗·鲁表示，被告试图以各种借口逃避支付到期款项，并在明知银行即将关闭的情况下鲁莽签发现金凭单。这是蓄意欺诈以剥夺人们钱财的行为，不能视为普通的商业失败。

刑事法庭庭长钱鸿业（Chien Hung Yieh）就除第一项指控外的所有指控讯问了陆梦湘和陆士豪。

陆梦湘回答说，“春和”的支票起初盖章不当。经协商，支票改为现金凭单。该凭单是在银行营业时间结束后签发的，因此无法付款；次日，银行关门停业。至于钱增林希望提取存款，由于手续不全，付款被推迟。关于未支付刘少 Chan 的支票，陆梦湘声称对此事不知情。至于4,000美元的现金凭单，在签发凭单之前，陆士豪已被告知该笔款项将用于维持银行运营。

陆士豪此时表示，在签发凭单之前他对此事并不知情。他说他只是春益银团（Chun Yi Banking Syndicate）常务委员会的一名成员。苏州、南市和上海西区的银行分行是在郭宏仁（Kuo Hung Ern）掌管银行期间设立的，但他（陆）当时并非常务委员会成员。

审计师徐表示，他未曾见过银行行政办事处的任何账簿。

随后问陆士侯行政办事处是否有任何账簿。

代表被告的律师吴公令（Woo Kung Ling）和范孔（Van Kong）均表示，行政办事处没有账簿，但有来自银行各分行的报告档案，但这些档案已被警方查封。

钱庭长就银行与国际慢步赛马会的关系以及王国资（Wong Kuo Tse）契据的抵押问题讯问了被告陆士侯。

陆士侯说：“王是我的妻子。去年十月，银行需要资金。王随后将四份契据抵押给银行营业部，借款7万美元。这笔钱后来存入银行储蓄部。我不知道储蓄部支付的利息是多少，但利息是合理的。随后，银行将这四份契据抵押给宁波商业银行，贷款50万美元。”

November 20, 1934. Morning Translation.

From Loh's statement President Chien
understood the object of mortgage.
When questioned, Loh Sih Hou denied
the object of the mortgage.
The President stated the $70,000 savings
deposit had been withdrawn before the expiration of
the period of deposit. According to an investigation
by the auditor, $30,000 of this sum had been used by
the International Trotting Club, $20,000 by the Hotel
Plaza, $15,000 by the Loh Tien Sz Ka (大世界)
Amusement Resort, while the remaining $5,000 were
spent in other business. The President questioned
Loh Sih Hou about these funds.
The President then asked accused Sung
Sih Zung (宋子文) :- "In connection with the
accounts for the purchase and sale of artificial
silk, there is according to the audit a difference
of over $9,000 in the accounts. Did you embezzle
this sum?"
Accused Sung strongly denied this.
As the Court had mentioned the International
Trotting Club, Mr. Paul Ru, Assistant Municipal
Advocate, made a statement regarding the investigation
into the Club made by the Police. He said :-
"The International Trotting Club was established by
accused Loh Sih Hou and an American named 'Fee-li-tuh-jen'
(非力特仁) with a capital of $500,000. Loh was
to raise the first half of the capital while the
American would raise the second half after the
Shanghai City Government had issued a permit to the
Club. However, the authorities prohibited the
opening of the Club. Over $300,000 had already
been spent on the Club. All this money had been
raised by Loh."
Lawyer Woo declared that the affairs of the
International Trotting Club had nothing to do with the
bank and that there was no necessity for an investigation
unless the money used by the Club had been drawn by
Loh Sih Hou by unlawful methods.
Lawyer Paul Ru charged Chen Chi Kan, Loh
Sih Hou, and others with having violated the Banking
Law and the Company's Ordinance. Van Ve Chien and
Chow Hsao Peng, who were in Court, were also charged.
According to Loh Sih Hou's statement, Chen
Chi Kan was the Chairman of the Board of Directors of
the Chun Yi Banking Syndicate. Wu Lee Hwa, Hong
Siang, and Loh Sih Hou were members of the Standing
Committee. Wu Lee Hwa and Loh Sih Hou received a
monthly pay of $200 each.
Upon being questioned, Wu Lee Hwa admitted
having held the post of Chief of the Business Section
of the Industrial Bank of China.
Van Ve Chien stated that he was an inspector
of the Administration Office. The old reports of the
various branches were kept in the treasury, but the
reports for this year had been taken away by the Police.

1934年11月20日。晨间译件。

根据罗（Loh）的陈述，钱院长（President Chien）了解了抵押的目的。
在接受讯问时，罗嗣侯（Loh Sih Hou）否认了该抵押的目的。
院长指出，70,000美元的储蓄存款在存期届满前已被提取。据审计员调查，这笔款项中有30,000美元被国际跑马总会（International Trotting Club）使用，20,000美元被华懋公寓（Hotel Plaza）使用，15,000美元被罗天司卡（即大世界）游乐场使用，其余5,000美元则用于其他业务。院长就这些资金向罗嗣侯提出质询。
随后，院长询问被告宋子中（Sung Sih Zung，音译）：“关于人造丝买卖的账目，根据审计，账目中存在超过9,000美元的差额。你是否侵吞了这笔款项？”
被告宋某强烈否认此事。
由于法庭提到了国际跑马总会，助理市检察官保罗·鲁（Paul Ru）先生就警方对该总会的调查作了陈述。他说：“国际跑马总会由被告罗嗣侯和一名名为‘非力特仁’（Fee-li-tuh-jen，音译）的美国人创立，资本为500,000美元。罗负责筹集前半部分资本，而该美国人将在上海市政府向该总会颁发许可证后筹集后半部分资本。然而，当局禁止该总会开业。在该总会上已花费超过300,000美元。所有这些资金均由罗筹集。”
吴律师声明，国际跑马总会的事务与银行无关，除非罗嗣侯通过非法手段提取了供该总会使用的资金，否则没有进行调查的必要。
保罗·鲁律师指控陈纪干（Chen Chi Kan，音译）、罗嗣侯等人违反《银行法》和《公司条例》。出庭的范伟坚（Van Ve Chien，音译）和周孝鹏（Chow Hsao Peng，音译）也受到指控。
根据罗嗣侯的陈述，陈纪干是春义银团（Chun Yi Banking Syndicate，音译）的董事会主席。吴礼华（Wu Lee Hwa，音译）、洪祥（Hong Siang，音译）和罗嗣侯是常务委员会成员。吴礼华和罗嗣侯每人每月领取薪金200美元。
在接受讯问时，吴礼华承认曾担任中国工业银行（Industrial Bank of China）业务科科长一职。
范伟坚称他是行政办公室的检查员。各分行的旧报告保存在金库中，但今年的报告已被警方带走。

November 29, 1934.    Machine Translation.

Witness Chang Sheh Liang ( 張世良 ) stated that
he was once the Chief of the Accountants Section of the
Industrial Bank of China. He discovered a shortage in
the accounts. For instance, he noticed that the amounts
deposited with the head bank by the various branches at
Sunchiang, Soochow, and in the French Concession were shown
in the accounts of the head bank at lower figures. He
informed his superiors of this matter and requested them
to rectify this, but his request was ignored. He, therefore,
tendered his resignation.
Dealing with the rate of interest paid by the
bank on deposits, the lawyer for the defence submitted a
newspaper containing an advertisement of a certain bank,
and stated that it was sufficient to show that the bank
of the accused was not the only concern which was paying
interest of more than one per cent per mensem on fixed
deposits for one year.
Chien Tseng Kin and Lieu Hsac Chai testified
to the non-payment of deposits by the accused.
President Chien informed Loh Sih Hou that
according to the investigation into the accounts, the
liabilities of the bank are about $900,000 and the assets
$600,000. There was thus a deficit of about $300,000,
made up mostly of savings deposits. The President
asked the accused whether he could make good the deficit.
Loh replied that he would make good any money
for which he was responsible.
The President then ordered that Loh Sih Hou be
still detained in custody and that Sun Chi Jen be released
on security of $10,000. The case was remanded for seven
days.

证人张世良（Chang Sheh Liang）陈述，他曾担任中国工业银行会计科科长。他发现账目存在短缺。例如，他注意到松江、苏州和法租界各分行存入总行的款项在总行账目中显示的数额较低。他将此事告知上级并要求予以纠正，但其请求被忽视。因此，他提出了辞职。
在处理银行支付给存款人的利率问题时，辩护律师提交了一份刊登有某银行广告的报纸，并指出这足以表明，被告所在的银行并非唯一一家对一年期定期存款支付月息超过百分之一的机构。
钱增金（Chien Tseng Kin，音译）和刘协斋（Lieu Hsac Chai，音译）作证证实被告未支付存款。
钱院长告知罗嗣侯，根据对账目的调查，银行的负债约为900,000美元，资产为600,000美元。因此存在约300,000美元的赤字，主要由储蓄存款构成。院长询问被告是否能弥补这一赤字。
罗回答说，他将赔偿由其负责的任何款项。
随后，院长命令继续羁押罗嗣侯，并准许孙吉人（Sun Chi Jen，音译）以10,000美元保释。案件延期七天审理。

The Iron News 1/ 12 , a mosquito paper, dated Nov.27:
THE CLOSING OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

The case arising out of the sudden closing
of the Industrial Bank of China is still pending.
During the past ten days, creditors have reported to
the police the amounts of their deposits in the bank.
Up to the present, the total amount of deposits thus
reported has reached over $400,000.
The staff of the Legal Department of
the Shanghai Municipal Council are busily engaged on
the case and as soon as their work has been completed,
the Municipal Advocate will file charges against Ich
Sih Hu (陸錫侯) and Ich Loong Siang (陸露祥).
A small number of creditors do not desire to
take criminal action against the accused in the hope
of having their deposits refunded. For this reason,
they have not reported to the police the amounts of
their deposits in the bank. These creditors have
retained their own lawyers to file a civil action
with the First Shanghai Special District Court for
the return of their deposits.

《铁报》，12月1日刊，小报，日期为11月27日：
中国工业银行停业

因中国工业银行突然停业引发的案件仍在审理中。在过去十天里，债权人已向警方申报其在银行的存款金额。截至目前，以此方式申报的存款总额已超过400,000美元。
上海公共租界工部局法律处的工作人员正忙于处理此案，一旦他们的工作完成，市检察官将对陆锡侯（Ich Sih Hu）和陆露祥（Ich Loong Siang）提起诉讼。
少数债权人不希望对被告采取刑事行动，希望能退还其存款。因此，他们未向警方申报其在银行的存款金额。这些债权人已聘请自己的律师，向上海第一特区地方法院提起民事诉讼，要求归还其存款。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 30, 1984

BANK FAILURE AND
TROTTING CLUB
Prosecution Follows
Disclosures Made
By Officials

During a hearing held on Wednesday, in the First Special District Court, it was revealed that the recently closed Industrial Bank of China had bad debts amounting to about $300,000. The hearing was adjourned for a week. The accused director of the bank, Mr. Loh Shih-hou, was remanded in custody while Mr. Sun Hsi-i.a, manager of a Chinese grocery shop who is alleged to have assisted Mr. Loh, was released on $10,000 bail.

Mr. Loh has been charged with fraud, misappropriation of bank funds and four other crimes in connection with the sudden voluntary liquidation of his bank. During the past few hearings it was revealed that the closure of his bank was closely related to the slow progress of the International Trotting Club which was financed by Mr. Loh and which could not be officially opened because its licence was refused by the Shanghai City Government.

On Wednesday Mr. Loh told the court that he started the club with an American friend with a capital of 3500,000 half of which was subscribed by him. The American shareholder would only participate in the organization after Mr. Loh had invested his share into the business and the Shanghai City Government granted a licence. Since no licence was granted the club had lost $300,000.

（批：Ray, Please help. MS）
（批：30/11）

银行倒闭与
跑马总会
官员披露后
随之而来的起诉

在周三于第一特区地方法院举行的听证会上，透露最近停业的中国工业银行坏账金额约为300,000美元。听证会休庭一周。该银行董事被告罗嗣侯（Mr. Loh Shih-hou）被还押候审，而据称协助罗先生的中国杂货店经理孙希仪（Mr. Sun Hsi-i.a，音译）则以10,000美元保释获释。

罗先生被控欺诈、挪用银行资金以及与其银行突然自愿清算相关的其他四项罪行。在过去的几次听证会上，透露出其银行的关闭与他资助的国际跑马总会进展缓慢密切相关，该总会因上海市政府拒绝颁发许可证而无法正式开业。

周三，罗先生告诉法庭，他与一位美国朋友共同创办了该总会，资本为350,000美元，其中一半由他认购。只有当罗先生将其份额投入业务且上海市政府颁发许可证后，这位美国股东才会参与组织工作。由于未获得许可证，该总会损失了300,000美元。

WARNING TO CLIENTS OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

Lawyer Sun Chu Chee (孙祖基) publishes the
following advertisement in the Sin Wan Pao on behalf of
Chang Foo In (张富仁) :-
"My client, Chang Foo In, states that in June this
year, he mortgaged two Title-deeds, one for a piece of land
measuring 0.135 mow situated on Route Frelupt, French
Consular Register No.2869 and Shanghai Municipal Register
No.9824A and the other for a piece of land measuring 1.484
mow, also situated on Route Frelupt, French Consular Register
No.1853 and the Shanghai Municipal Register No.10248, with
the Industrial Bank of China as security for over-draft.

to redeem the mortgages on a certain date, but that the

action.
"With a view to preventing the public from being
victimised, he asks me to insert this notification."

致中国工业银行客户的警告

孙祖基（Sun Chu Chee）律师代表张富仁（Chang Foo In）在《新闻报》（Sin Wan Pao）上刊登如下广告：
“我的委托人张富仁声明，今年六月，他将两张地契抵押给中国工业银行，作为透支的担保。其中一张地契涉及位于弗雷吕普路（Route Frelupt，音译，即今复兴中路一带）的一块土地，面积为0.135亩，法国领事馆登记号为2869，上海公共租界登记号为9824A；另一张地契也位于弗雷吕普路，面积为1.484亩，法国领事馆登记号为1853，上海公共租界登记号为10248。他说他曾写信给银行，请求允许在特定日期赎回抵押品，但银行起初不予回复，后来又以各种借口推迟赎回。
“我的委托人声明，他已将一笔款项存入法院，并对银行提起诉讼，要求归还文件。在诉讼解决之前，他不承认任何地契的转让、买卖行为有效。

Nov. ber 1, 1934. Morning Transl tion.

China Evening News and other local newspapers:

CLOSING OF THE INDUSTRIAL ... K OF CHINA

With reference to the closing of the Industrial
Bank of China, the Shanghai Municipal Police recently
discovered that the Vice-Manager, Loh Meng Shiang (陸愛薌),
a native of Hangchow, who knew of the insolvency of
the concern, signed and issued a native order on the
Bank on October 9 valued at $1,150 to be payable on
October 11. The holder of the order was unable to
cash the order when it was due. Such action on the
part of Loh Meng Shian constitutes the crime of fraud.
A few days ago, the Municipal Police applied
for and secured a warrant of arrest for Loh Meng Shiang
from the First Shanghai Special District Court.
Detectives were sent to visit Loh's home, No. 5 Ferry
Road, to arrest him, but failed to do so.
On October 30 Loh Meng Shiang attended
Court as a witness when he was arrested and taken to
Chengtu Road Police Station.
The case against Loh Meng Shiang was heard
in the First Special District Court on the morning of
October 31 when the Assistant Municipal Advocate, Wong
Yao Drung, presented the particulars of the case.
After questioning Loh concerning his age and
nativity, the Court ordered him to be released on $10,000
bail as the case is to be heard together with Loh Shih
Hou's case.

《中国晚报》及其他本地报纸：

中国工业银行停业

关于中国工业银行停业一事，上海公共租界警务处最近发现，副经理罗爱香（Loh Meng Shiang，音译，杭州人）在知晓该行资不抵债的情况下，于10月9日签发了一张价值1,150美元的本行本票，定于10月11日付款。持票人在到期时无法兑现该本票。罗爱香的这种行为构成了欺诈罪。
几天前，市警方向上海第一特区地方法院申请并获得了针对罗爱香的逮捕令。侦探前往罗的住所斐伦路5号（No. 5 Ferry Road，音译，即今延安东路附近或具体路名需考证，此处依原文译）进行逮捕，但未能成功。
10月30日，罗爱香作为证人出庭时被逮捕，并被带至成都路警察局。
针对罗爱香的案件于10月31日上午在第一特区地方法院审理，助理市检察官黄耀宗（Wong Yao Drung，音译）陈述了案件详情。
在讯问了罗的年龄和籍贯后，法庭命令他以10,000美元保释，因为该案将与罗嗣侯的案件合并审理。

October 31, 1934. Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE COAL MERCHANTS ASSOCIATION AND THE PUBLIC HEALTH
DEPARTMENT OF THE S.M.C.

Yesterday the Coal Merchants Association sent
the following letter to the Chinese Ratepayers' Association:-
"We are in receipt of a letter from the Ih
Chen Sin ( 彝 成 新 ) Coal Company, a member of our
Association, on Avenue Edward VII, reading as follows:-
'When coal is loaded or unloaded in front of
our company, it is unavoidable that fragments of
coal will remain on the ground. These are swept
off from time to time. A foreman of garbage coolies,
however, always notes our house number. We have been
fined many times. The more times we are summoned,
the heavier the fines.
'We cannot stop to load or unload our cargo
even for one day because of the fines, but how can
we carry on our business when our house number is
frequently noted and fines are imposed.
'We shall, therefore, be much obliged if you
will write to the Chinese Ratepayers Association
requesting it to take the matter up with the Public
Health Department of the Shanghai Municipal Council.'
"We have found the above statement is correct.
The Public Health Department of the Shanghai Municipal
Council believes only the reports of its foreman and
acts in the matter without taking into consideration the
real situation. The frequent imposition of a fine causes
the company a lot of trouble. Please write to the
Public Health Department of the Shanghai Municipal Council
asking it whether the coal company acts against the
regulations. If the company does not act against the
regulations, no fines should be imposed."

China Times and other local newspapers:

D 6225.
THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA IS SEALED
UP BY THE COURT

After the Industrial Bank of China, 172
Nanking Road, had closed its doors, the Ministry of Finance
instructed the Bureau of Social Affairs of the Shanghai
City Government to request the City Chamber of Commerce
to conduct an investigation into the closing of the Bank.
The Chamber has submitted a report to the Ministry.
The First Special District Court has accepted
the charges brought by creditors against the Bank, while
the Police of the International Settlement have filed
a public prosecution against Loh Shih Hou, a director of
the Bank.
Yesterday the premises of the Bank on Nanking
Road were sealed up by the Special District Court.

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

煤业公会与工部局公共卫生处

昨日，煤业公会致函华人纳税会，信件内容如下：
“本会会员、位于爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）的彝成新煤号来函称：‘在我号门前装卸煤炭时，难免有碎煤散落在地。我方不时进行清扫。然而，垃圾苦力的一名工头总是记下我号的门牌号码。我方已被罚款多次。传讯次数越多，罚款越重。
‘因惧怕罚款，我方甚至不敢停工一日以停止装卸货物，但既然门牌号常被记录并处以罚款，业务又如何能维持下去。
‘因此，如蒙贵会致函上海公共租界工部局公共卫生处，提请其关注此事，我们将不胜感激。’
“经查，上述陈述属实。上海公共租界工部局公共卫生处仅听信其工头的报告，在不考虑实际情况的前提下采取行动。频繁罚款给该公司带来诸多困扰。请致函上海公共租界工部局公共卫生处，询问该煤号是否违反规章。若该公司未违规，则不应处以罚款。”

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

中国兴业银行被法院查封

位于南京路172号的中国兴业银行停业后，财政部指令上海市政府社会局请求市商会对该行停业一事进行调查。商会已向财政部提交报告。
第一特区地方法院已受理债权人对该行提出的指控，同时公共租界巡捕房对该行董事陆锡侯（Loh Shih Hou）提起公诉。
昨日，该行位于南京路的营业场所被特区地方法院查封。

6225.
Date 28. 10. 34

October 28, 1934.                                         Morning Translation

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

THE AFFAIRS OF THE CHINA INDUSTRIAL BANK

    The local Bureau of Social Affairs has
been instructed by the Ministry of Finance to make an
investigation into the cause of the bankruptcy and other
particulars of the China Industrial Bank. The Bureau
later issued the following order to the Chamber of
Commerce:-
    "In the 20th year of the Chinese Republic,
the China Industrial Bank on Nanking Road was sold to
Loh Shih Hou for $150,000, but the Bank did not petition
the Ministry of Finance for registration. Furthermore,
the Bank arbitrarily established branches at Soochow and
Sungkiang to secure savings deposits by means of fraud.
The Bank had eight branches which have collected deposits
amounting to more than $1,000,000. These funds were
mostly used in speculations and illegal investments.
Several hundred thousand dollars of the deposits were
used to establish the International Trotting Club under
the name of certain foreigners. The Trotting Club was
to have been an open gambling institution. In the
interest of the people, we request you to investigate
into the capital, deposits, funds, and the activities of
Loh Shih Hou and to submit a report. At the same time,
you are to devise means to suppress the International
Trotting Club"

    The following petition has been submitted
by the Chinese Chamber of Commerce to the Bureau of Social
Affairs:-
    "With reference to your instruction
No.9883 ordering this Chamber to furnish you with information
regarding the causes of the insolvency of the Industrial
Bank of China and its past history, we have to state that at
the time of its organization, the Bank registered with
the Government in Peking. The Chairman of the Board
of Directors was Sun T'ien Ling (孫殿林). The head office
was at Hankow with a branch office in Shanghai. In the
Winter of 1926, upon the fall of Hankow and Hanyang
into the hands of the Nationalist Army, the head office
was removed to Shanghai. In the Winter of 1931, owing to
difficulties as a result of speculations, the Bank was
taken over by Loh Shih Hou and two others for a consideration
of $150,000 in the name of the Chung Yih Banking Syndicate
(中益銀團). At first Ying Shok Sung (殷石笙), a share-
holder, was appointed General Manager, and Zing Bao Yuan
(秦抱元), who has now absconded, was at this time employed
as manager. Branches were established at Soochow and
Sungkiang in that year. Because of poor business, the
Bank soon lost its capital of $150,000. Ying Sheh Sung
then resigned his position. A General Administration
Department was instituted under Kao En Hung (高恩洪) as the
chairman of the Board of Directors. Two Branches were
opened; one in Nantaw and the other in the French
Concession.

6225.
日期 34年10月28日

1934年10月28日。                                         晨间译件

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

中国兴业银行事宜

    本地社会局奉财政部指令，调查中国兴业银行破产原因及其他详情。该局随后向商会发出如下命令：
    “民国二十年，南京路中国兴业银行以十五万元的价格出售给陆锡侯，但该银行并未向财政部申请注册。此外，该银行擅自在苏州和松江设立分行，通过欺诈手段吸纳储蓄存款。该银行共有八家分行，吸收存款总额超过一百万元。这些资金大多用于投机和非法投资。存款中的数十万元被用于以某些外国人的名义建立国际跑马总会（International Trotting Club）。该跑马总会原本计划成为一家公开的赌博机构。为了民众利益，请贵会调查陆锡侯的资本、存款、资金及其活动情况，并提交报告。同时，请设法取缔国际跑马总会。”

    上海总商会向社会局提交了以下呈文：
    “关于贵局第9883号指令，要求本会提供有关中国兴业银行倒闭原因及其过往历史的信息，兹陈述如下：该行成立时，曾向北平政府注册。董事会主席为孙殿林（Sun T'ien Ling）。总行设在汉口，并在上海设有分行。1926年冬，随着汉口和汉阳落入国民革命军手中，总行迁至上海。1931年冬，由于投机困难，该行由陆锡侯等两人以中益银团（Chung Yih Banking Syndicate）的名义，作价十五万元接管。起初，股东殷石笙（Ying Shok Sung）被任命为总经理，此时聘用的经理为现已潜逃的秦抱元（Zing Bao Yuan）。同年，在苏州和松江设立了分行。由于生意不佳，银行很快亏空了十五万元的资本。殷石笙随即辞职。随后成立了由高恩洪（Kao En Hung）担任董事会主席的总管理处。开设了两家分行；一家在南市，另一家在法租界。

pages.en:
October 28, 193
Kormir Translation

No. 6
"In the summer of 1933, due to differences of opinions among the shareholders, the Bank was transferred to Loh Shih Hou.
"At this time, the resources of the Bank were already somewhat exhausted. Loh Shih Hou did not put any capital into the Bank but deposited some money in other names to maintain the Bank. All the directors and supervisors were appointed by Loh, who was in control of the affairs of the Bank. Because the Bank was conducted in an erratic manner and no distinction was made between the various transactions of a bank, coupled with insufficient reserves, the condition of the Bank became precarious.
"The immediate and principal cause for the sudden closing of the Bank was the failure of the International Trotting Club. Large sums of money had been withdrawn from the Bank to finance the Club. The authorities refused to issue a licence to the Club. Upon learning of this, the depositors created a run on the Bank. Loh Shih Hou did his utmost to maintain the Bank by securing money from other sources but owing to the fact that Zing Bao Yuan, the manager, was carrying on two subsidiary companies known as the Sin Hwa Trading Company and the Dah Sung Chong Sundry Goods Store and was issuing cheques on the Bank to pay for the purchases for the two concerns, both the Bank and its branches became involved in financial difficulties. Upon being informed of this, creditors of the Bank became alarmed and demanded payment.
"The Bank was not registered with the National Government when it was taken over by the present shareholders. Therefore, the Government had no knowledge of the condition of the Bank, while the public was also kept in the dark.
"We are of the opinion that the Government should enforce the regulations governing the establishment of banks against all banks which have not registered with the Government in order to protect the public from being victimized."

THE RELIEF OF PATRIOTS

The Various Circles Patriots Support Committee will hold a meeting at 2 p.m. to-day to consider the question of rendering relief to patriot Liang Dong Fang ( ), who has been arrested for throwing bombs as a warning to a traitorous merchant against dealing in Japanese goods and to afford relief to patriot Pen Hung Sung ( ), who is seriously ill.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:

CHAUFFEURS OF JOHNSON GARAGE RESUME WORK

In connection with the strike of chauffeurs of the Johnson Garage, Mr. Doo Yuch Sung yesterday afternoon held a mediation meeting which was attended by representatives from the chauffeurs' union, the workers of the Garage, the District Tangpu, the General Labour Union and the Garage.
It was decided that all the strikers resume work. An agreement was signed by both parties. The night shift chauffeurs resumed work at midnight and the rest will resume operations to-day.

第6号
“1933年夏，由于股东之间意见分歧，该行转让给陆锡侯。
“此时，该行的资源已有些枯竭。陆锡侯未向银行注入任何资本，而是以其他名义存入一些款项以维持银行运营。所有董事和监事均由陆锡侯任命，由其掌控银行事务。由于银行经营方式 erratic（反复无常/不规范），且各类银行业务之间没有区分，加之准备金不足，银行的状况变得岌岌可危。
“导致银行突然停业的直接和主要原因，是国际跑马总会的失败。大量资金从银行抽出以资助该总会。当局拒绝向该总会颁发执照。得知此消息后，储户对银行进行了挤兑。陆锡侯竭尽全力通过其他渠道筹措资金以维持银行，但由于经理秦抱元经营着两家附属公司，即新华贸易公司（Sin Hwa Trading Company）和大成杂货店（Dah Sung Chong Sundry Goods Store），并开具银行支票支付这两家公司的购货款，导致银行及其分行均陷入财务困境。银行债权人获悉此事后感到恐慌，要求付款。
“该行被现有股东接管时，并未向国民政府注册。因此，政府不了解该行的状况，公众也被蒙在鼓里。
“我们认为，政府应对所有未在政府注册的银行强制执行银行设立法规，以保护公众免受侵害。”

Miscellaneous (:)

It will be recalled that the price of the drug has been recently raised from $65 to $800 per picul as a result of the Ningpo merchants restricting its export to Shanghai (Vide I.R. 5/9/34). Consequently the majority of the medicine shops in Shanghai ceased dealing in the drug as a counter-measure against the action of the former, (Vide I.R. 20/9/34) the boycott being still in force.

Run on the National Industrial Bank of China

A slight run on the National Industrial Bank of China, 130 Peking Road, occurred on October 26. A similar run was experienced by its branch at Soochow four days ago. Trouble was averted in both cases by the promptness of the Bank in cashing its note issue. At present the Management of the Bank is prepared to extend business hours if necessary to restore confidence and it now appears that the run has ceased. Discreet enquiries among local banking circles have so far failed to ascertain the cause of the run, but there is reason to believe that the Chinese title of the bank "Tsung Kuc Tzuh Nyih Nyung Hong" (中國實業銀行) which differs only in one character from the defunct Industrial Bank of China, in Chinese "Tsung Kuc Shih Nyih Nyung Hong" (中國興業銀行) raised doubts in the minds of some ignorant proprietors of small exchange shops who decided to be on the safe side by refusing to cash the banknotes of the former thus leading to rumours as to the bank's financial soundness.

需指出的是，由于宁波商人限制该药品出口至上海，其价格最近已从每担65元涨至800元（参见 I.R. 34年9月5日）。因此，上海大多数药店作为对此举的对策，停止交易该药品（参见 I.R. 34年9月20日），抵制行动仍在继续。

对中国实业银行的挤兑

10月26日，位于北京路130号的中国实业银行发生轻微挤兑。四天前，其苏州分行也经历了类似的挤兑。在这两起事件中，银行均因迅速兑现其发行的钞票而避免了事态恶化。目前，银行管理层准备在必要时延长营业时间以恢复信心，现在看来挤兑已经停止。在当地银行界的谨慎问询迄今未能查明挤兑的原因，但有理由相信，该行的中文名称“中国实业银行”（Tsung Kuc Tzuh Nyih Nyung Hong）与已倒闭的中国兴业银行中文名称“中国兴业银行”（Tsung Kuc Shih Nyih Nyung Hong）仅一字之差，引起了一些无知的小钱庄业主的疑虑，他们决定采取稳妥做法，拒绝兑现前者的钞票，从而导致关于该银行财务稳健性的谣言。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, FRIDAY, OCTOBER 26, 1934.

Bank Funds Not Used For
Trotting Club, Says Loh

Industrial Bank Chairman Is Again In Court; Judge
Directs Complaints By Creditors To Be
Made Through The Police

Strong denials that he had used funds belonging to his bank for the purpose of financing a concern known as the International Trotting Club were made by Mr. Loh Shih-hou, Chairman of Directors of the recently closed Industrial Bank of China, when yesterday he appeared for the second time at the First Special Court to face charges of fraud.

Mr. Loh told Judge Chien yesterday that he had financed the International Trotting Club with his own funds, having invested about $200,000 savings in the concern. Not one copper of the bank's funds had been used for the purpose, he declared.

The case was adjourned sine die pending further investigations by the police.

It was stated by the prosecution at last Wednesday's hearing that cheques issued by Loh on the Industrial Bank of China had not been met, and it was alleged that goods bought by Loh with the cheques had been sold in order to provide funds for the International Trotting Club.

Before adjourning the case on that occasion, Judge Chien directed that creditors of the Bank must lodge all claims through the Police.

It is reported that the Police are still looking for Ching Pao-yuen, manager of the closed bank, and Wong Yih-hsi, a member of the bank's auditing department, charges having been framed against both.

《字林西报》，1934年10月26日，星期五。

罗氏称银行资金未用于跑马总会

中国实业银行董事长再次出庭；法官指示债权人须通过警方提出申诉

近日停业的中国实业银行（Industrial Bank of China）董事长罗士侯（Loh Shih-hou）先生昨日第二次出现在第一特区法院特别法庭，面对欺诈指控时，强烈否认曾动用其银行资金为一家名为“国际跑马总会”（International Trotting Club）的机构提供融资。

罗士侯昨日告诉钱法官，他是用个人资金资助国际跑马总会的，在该机构中投入了约20万美元的储蓄。他宣称，未曾挪用银行的一分一毫用于此目的。

案件因等待警方进一步调查而无限期休庭。

检方在上周三的听证会上陈述，罗士侯从中国实业银行开出的支票未能兑现，并指控罗士侯用这些支票购买货物后将其出售，以为国际跑马总会筹集资金。

当时法官在休庭前指示，该银行的债权人必须通过警方登记所有债权诉求。

据悉，警方仍在寻找已停业银行的经理秦兆元（Ching Pao-yuen，音译，注：下文作Zing Bao Yuen）以及该银行审计部成员黄益之（Wong Yih-hsi，音译），两人均已被起诉。

In connection with the closure of the

giving an outline of the investigations made by the
Police during the period of remand, said :- "During
the period of remand the Police made further enquiries
and discovered that during this year the accused Loh
Shih Hou had acted improperly in dealing with all
matters relating to the Bank. Several creditors
have lodged complaints with the Police against Loh
for inducing people to deposit their savings with
his Bank. The total amount can not yet be ascertained
until the Chartered Accountants have completed their
work. Loh Shih Hou is the responsible person of the
Bank. The condition and the organization of the Bank

《时报》及其他本地报纸：

中国实业银行案

关于中国实业银行停业一事，针对罗士侯（陸侯）和孙希仁（孫希仁）的案件审理于昨日下午2点在第一特区法院第一刑事法庭恢复进行，主审法官为钱鸿业（Tien Hung Nyik）。辩护律师为吴麟坤（Woo Ling Kwen）和范刚（Van Kong）。

助理巡捕房检察官保罗·鲁（Paul Ru）在概述了还押期间警方所做的调查后表示：“在还押期间，警方进行了进一步问询，发现被告罗士侯在今年处理与银行有关的所有事务中存在不当行为。多名债权人已向警方投诉罗士侯，指控其诱使人们将储蓄存入其银行。在特许会计师完成工作之前，总金额尚无法确定。罗士侯是银行的负责人。银行的状况和组织结构已构成违反《银行法》第46、47和48条。该银行的储蓄部未在财政部注册，也未申请经营储蓄业务的许可证。这构成了违反《储蓄银行监理条例》第16条。警方正依据这些法律提出进一步指控。将传唤数名证人以证明银行状况不佳，并显示储蓄存款被不当使用。警方还查明，该银行某些员工仅挂名在册。这些人每月领取约100元的车马费。他们对银行的状况一无所知。我请求法庭将案件发回还押。警方需进行进一步调查。”

经法庭传唤，证人赵凤山（Zau Feng San，音译，注：下文作Hsao Feng San/郝鳳山）作出如下陈述：“我为新华贸易公司（Sin Hwa Trading Company）的附属机构大生昌百货店（Dah Sung Chong Sundry Goods Store）负责采购人造丝。大生昌百货店没有经理，店内所有交易均由新华贸易公司经理孙希仁指挥。大生昌百货店成立于1934年8月29日。此前我在新华公司任职，后调至大生昌百货店。大生昌百货店采购的人造丝交给新华公司销售。大生昌百货店购买人造丝的成本由该店开出的支票支付。随后该支票在中国实业银行兑换为本票（native order）。”

October 27, 1934. Morning Translation.

Bank of China. Sung Shi Zung negotiated with the Industrial Bank for a native order and I had no knowledge of this. I do not know to what use the money obtained from the selling of the artificial silk was put. The transaction in artificial silk with the Mitsui Busson Kaisha was handled by me. After the closing of the Dah Sung Chong Store, I handed the account books of the Store to Sung Shi Zung on September 26 for custody. The Sin Hwa Trading Company was established by Zing Bao Yuen (秦兆元), Sung Shi Zung, a certain person named Yao (姚) and others. As Zing Bao Yuen sold silk at cheap prices, I became suspicious and questioned him about the matter. Zing replied that the International Trotting Club organized by Loh Shih Hou required a large sum of money and that all the funds of the Club had been advanced by the Industrial Bank. Zing added that as the Bank was seriously affected by the advance of these sums, he adopted this plan in order to meet the exhausted resources of the Bank."
Witness Li Shing Kai (李興凱) said:-
"I undertake the buying of silk for the Dah Sung Chong Sundry Store. Zau Fong San is the Manager of the Store. Zau said that Zing Bao Yuen was the owner of the Store. Originally, I was in the service of the Sin Hwa Trading Company. The transactions in artificial silk were made through a person named Chu (邱). The goods were stored in the home of Zing Bao Yuen and sold by the Sin Hwa Trading Company. The Dah Sung Chong Store was closed on September 25 or 26, on which date it was known that Zing Bao Yuen had absconded. Since then, Zau Fong San had not visited the Store. However, three persons named Loh (羅), Chow (周) and Zing (秦) visited the Store at the same time and inquired about the goods and the accounts of the Store. I reported the matter to Sung Shi Zung."
Loh Shih Hou made the following statement:-
"I was a member of the Board of Directors of the Chung Yih Banking Syndicate which was organized by Kao En Hung (高恩洪), Yin Shih Sung (殷石嵩) and myself. In the 21st year of the Chinese Republic, the Syndicate produced $150,000 to take over the Bank from Sun Tan Ling (孫丹林). I procured 50% of the amount and Kao and Yin the balance. Yin was then appointed General Manager. Later, owing to the fact that Yin had misappropriated a sum of $50,000, I took over the Bank and placed it under my own management. That was in June or July last year. I also put in additional capital of $150,000 to maintain the Bank."
The Judge asked Loh whether he had a Board of Directors, the names of the members of the Board.
Loh did not give clear answers to all these questions.
Loh then went on to state that the International Trotting Club was established in May this year with a capital of $500,000. He procured 50% of the sum. The balance was invested by certain foreigners.
The Judge ordered Loh to give the names of the shareholders.

银行。孙希仁与中国实业银行洽谈本票事宜，我对此并不知情。我不知道出售人造丝所得款项用于何处。与三井物产株式会社（Mitsui Busson Kaisha）的人造丝交易由我经手。大生昌百货店关闭后，我于9月26日将该店的账簿交给孙希仁保管。新华贸易公司由秦兆元（Zing Bao Yuen）、孙希仁、一位姓姚（Yao）的人及其他人成立。由于秦兆元以低价出售丝绸，我产生怀疑并向他询问此事。秦回答说，罗士侯组织的国际跑马总会需要一大笔钱，俱乐部的所有资金均由中国实业银行垫付。秦补充说，由于银行因垫付这些款项受到严重影响，他采取此计划以应对银行枯竭的资源。”

证人李兴凯（Li Shing Kai）说：“我为大生昌百货店负责采购丝绸。赵凤山是该店经理。赵说秦兆元是该店店主。起初，我在新华贸易公司任职。人造丝交易是通过一位姓邱（Chu）的人进行的。货物存放在秦兆元家中，由新华贸易公司销售。大生昌百货店于9月25日或26日关闭，当日得知秦兆元已潜逃。此后，赵凤山未再去过该店。然而，有三位分别姓罗（Loh）、周（Chow）和秦（Zing）的人同时来到店里，查询货物和店铺账目。我将此事报告给了孙希仁。”

罗士侯作出如下陈述：“我是由高二洪（Kao En Hung，音译）、殷石嵩（Yin Shih Sung，音译）和我自己组织的众义银团（Chung Yih Banking Syndicate）的董事成员。在民国二十一年，该银团出资15万美元从孙丹林（Sun Tan Ling）手中接管了该银行。我筹措了其中的50%，高和殷筹措了剩余部分。殷随后被任命为总经理。后来，由于殷挪用了5万美元，我接管了该银行并亲自管理。那是去年六月或七月的事。我还追加了15万美元资本以维持银行运营。”

法官询问罗士侯是否有董事会，以及董事会成员的姓名。

罗士侯对所有这些问题均未给出清晰回答。

罗士侯接着陈述，国际跑马总会于今年五月成立，资本为50万美元。他筹措了其中的50%。剩余部分由某些外国人投资。

法官命令罗士侯提供股东名单。

Loh gave one name only and stated that the Club was registered with the American authorities and that all the account books were in the hands of the foreigners. "The Sin Hwa Trading Company was established at the beginning of April this year. The shareholders of this Company are Zing Bao Yuen and one named Yao. The capital was $6,000. It had originally been planned to await the co-operation of a French citizen, but the latter failed to come to Shanghai after the establishment of the Company. At first, the Company dealt in cotton cloth only. Hsao Feng San(郝鳳山) was introduced to the Company by Zing Bao Yuen, while the man named Chiu(邱) was introduced to the Company by me. The Company began dealing in artificial silk in May or June. Shortly afterward, this business was stopped because there was no profit. In August, Zing Bao Yuen resumed the business in artificial silk. According to Zing Bao Yuen, the resources of the Industrial Bank of China were already exhausted. As he was the Manager of the Bank, he had to devise every means to maintain the Bank. The purchase of artificial silk was decided upon because the proceeds from its sale could be used to meet the immediate requirements of the Bank, while the purchase could be paid for with 10 day cheques. If the plan could maintain the Bank until the inauguration of the International Trotting Club, the financial condition of the Bank would have improved. Since Zing had decided to maintain the Bank in this manner, I, being an employee of Zing, had to assist him to the best of my ability. Quantities of artificial silk were bought and sold. All the transactions were executed very rapidly and the Bank, in some instances, had no time to enter them into account books. I afterwards felt that if the transactions were to continue to be carried out in this erratic manner, it would be difficult to trace the transactions. At this time, the French man, who is a partner in the Company, arrived, while a man named Chu, who undertook all the transactions in artificial silk, was unwilling to continue this work. I therefore held a consultation with Zing and as a result of the discussion, the establishment of another company called the Dah Sung Chong Sundry Goods Store was decided upon. The new store would undertake purchases, while the Sin Hwa Trading Company would dispose of the goods. All the proceeds from the sale of the artificial silk were paid by Zing into the Bank, or handed to Yuan Chue (Zing Bao Yuen himself), or to the Dah Sung Chong Sundry Goods Store. The records of these payments can be traced in the account books. On the evening of the Mid-Autumn Festival, Zing summoned me to a hotel where we hold a meeting. Zing said that despite the purchase and

CHINESE GOVERNMENT AND SAVINGS SOCIETIES

On October 26 the Ministry of Finance wrote
to the Savings Custodian Committee to the effect that the
International Savings Society, the L'Epargne Franco-
Chinoise and other similar companies must comply with
Article 9 of the Regulations governing Savings banks.

deposit with the Central Bank one-fourth of the total

security. No exception will be made by the Ministry.

China Times and other local newspapers:
THE CASE OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA
The Industrial Bank of China, 172 Nanking Road, suddenly closed its doors on October 11. Zing Bao Yuan (秦抱元), the Manager of the Bank, has since disappeared with a large sum of money, while Loh Shih Hou (羅錫侯), Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Bank, has been charged by the Mitsui Bussan Kaisha with failing to honour a cheque due. Last Saturday, Loh was arrested by the Central Police Station and charged at the First Special District Court with obtaining money under false pretences. Loh was brought before the court the other day and ordered to be detained.
The number of creditors of the Bank is said to be considerable. The liabilities of the Bank amount to several hundred thousand dollars. When the Bank first closed its doors, these creditors did not know what to do until the Mitsui Bussan Kaisha brought a charge of fraud against Loh Shih Hou. The Mitsui Bussan Kaisha reported the matter to the Police and produced evidence. The Police instituted a public prosecution against Loh. The creditors then instituted a private prosecution.
Last Monday, when Loh Shih Hou appeared before the Court, only two creditors named Chien Tseng Ming (錢尊明) and Sun Ping Wen (沈秉文) submitted petitions to the Court.
Chien Tseng Ming, who charged Loh Shih Hou only, told the Court that on October 7 he wished to draw, through the Silk Trade Bank (絲業銀行), a sum of $2,000 plus $220 interest from the Industrial Bank of China, but the latter Bank informed the Silk Trade Bank that he must draw the money in person. When he went there a few days later, he found that the Bank had closed its doors.
Chien added that as the Manager of the Bank, Zing Bao Yuan, had absconded, Loh Shih Hou should be held responsible. He charged Loh with misappropriation of money and demanded the payment of his deposits.
Sun Ping Wen charged Loh Shih Hou, Zing Bao Yuan, and Wong Yih She (王翼軒), a member of the Auditing Department of the Bank, with fraud, because they had failed to pay cash for certain cheques which were due.

《时报》及其他本地报纸：
中国工业银行案
位于南京路172号的中国工业银行于10月11日突然关门。该行经理秦抱元（Zing Bao Yuan）此后携巨款潜逃，而该行常务委员会主席罗锡侯（Loh Shih Hou）被三井物产株式会社指控未能兑付到期支票。上周六，罗被中央捕房逮捕，并在第一特区地方法院被控以虚假借口骗取钱财。罗日前被提审，并被命令羁押。
据悉，该银行的债权人数目众多。该银行的债务达数十万元。当该银行最初关门时，这些债权人不知所措，直到三井物产株式会社对罗锡侯提出欺诈指控。三井物产株式会社向警方报案并提供证据。警方对罗提起公诉。随后债权人们提起自诉。
上周一，当罗锡侯出庭时，只有两名名为钱尊明（Chien Tseng Ming）和沈秉文（Sun Ping Wen）的债权人向法院提交了诉状。
仅控告罗锡侯的钱尊明告诉法院，10月7日，他希望通过丝业银行从中国工业银行提取2,000美元及220美元利息，但后者银行通知丝业银行，他必须亲自取款。几天后当他前往该行时，发现银行已关门。
钱补充说，由于银行经理秦抱元已潜逃，罗锡侯应承担责任。他指控罗挪用资金，并要求偿还其存款。
沈秉文指控罗锡侯、秦抱元以及银行稽核部成员王翼轩（Wong Yih She）犯有欺诈罪，因为他们未能兑付某些到期的支票现金。
昨日下午，刘（Liu）法官传唤原告到庭，并命令从中央捕房提押罗锡侯。罗的辩护律师范刚（Van Kong）和吴灵坤（Woo Ling Kwen）也出席了庭审。
刘法官告知案件所有利害关系人，罗锡侯等人正受到警方的公诉，希望

Eastern Times and other local newspapers :-

Government And Small Banks

In view of the fact that many small
banks in Shanghai are holding out high rates of
interest to induce people to deposit their savings
in these banks, the Ministry of Finance has instructed
the Bureau of Social Affairs to suppress these banks.
In an interview with our reporter,
Li Ling Sien (李凌先), secretary of the Bureau
of Social Affairs, said :- "The Bureau will prohibit
all banks which have not registered with the Ministry

WOMAN RED PILL ADDICT & NARCOTIC SMUGGLERS EXECUTED

At 2 p.m. October 24 the Changchow
Hsien Government executed two persons for smuggling

October 23, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

China Times:

THE CASE OF THE INDUSTRIAL BANK OF CHINA

When the Industrial Bank of China, 172 Nanking Road, suddenly closed its doors some days ago, the liabilities of the Bank amounted to more than $500,000. As most of the creditors of the Bank are poor people, the hardships of these creditors in consequence of the closing of the Bank are beyond description. Therefore, the Police Department of the Shanghai Municipal Council paid close attention to the affair and detailed Chinese and foreign detectives to conduct an investigation. Their findings convinced the Police authorities that the sudden closing of the Bank had been premeditated.

The organization of this Bank is very peculiar, there being neither registered shareholders nor directors and supervisors. Loh Shih Hou (陸錫侯) is the only member of the Standing Committee, and is responsible for the affairs of the Bank. The Bank had not registered with the Ministry of Finance, nor had a permit been issued to it by the National Government.

In addition to carrying on ordinary banking business, the Bank had a savings department holding out a high rate of interest to induce poor people to deposit their savings with the Bank. These savings were utilized by the Bank to finance other business. Among Loh Shih Hou's other investments are the Small World Amusement Resort, the Hotel Plaza, the Tangshan Bath House, the Auditorium, the International Trotting Club and others. The International Trotting Club having been found to be a gambling establishment, the authorities refused to issue a licence. Loh had bought 150 horses from abroad at a cost of $1,000 each and engaged a number of jockeys from abroad. A large sum of money was spent by Loh on the transportation of those horses to Shanghai, and since their arrival, the animals were fed at a cost of about Tls. 1,000 a day. The inauguration of the International Trotting Club has been in abeyance for three months already and the loss sustained through the upkeep of the club must have amounted to a considerable figure. All the money to meet the expenses were advanced by the Industrial Bank of China.

Finding that the resources of the Bank were being exhausted, Loh Shih Hou conspired with Zing Bao Yuan (秦抱元), the Manager of the Bank, who has since absconded, and Sun Shi Zung (孫希仁), the Manager of the Sin Hwa Trading Company (新華貿易公司) and of the Dah Sung Chong Sundry Goods Store (大生昌雜貨號), who is a native of Hangchow, to find ready cash to maintain the International Trotting Club.

Several days before the closing of the Bank, Sun Shi Zung bought large quantities of merchandise on the account of the Sin Hwa Trading Company and the Dah Sung Chong Sundry Goods Store, from various companies and paid for them with cheques drawn on the Industrial Bank of China. By disposing of the goods thus obtained at a reduced price, they secured cash to meet their requirements.

《时报》：

中国工业银行案

前几天，位于南京路172号的中国工业银行突然关门，该银行的债务超过50万美元。由于该银行的大多数债权人是穷人，银行关门给这些债权人带来的苦难难以言表。因此，上海公共租界工部局警务处密切关注此事，并派遣中西探员进行调查。调查结果使警方当局确信，该银行的突然关门是预谋已久的。

该银行的组织结构非常特殊，既无注册股东，也无董事和监事。陆锡侯（Loh Shih Hou）是常务委员会的唯一成员，负责银行事务。该银行未在财政部注册，国民政府也未向其颁发许可证。

除了开展普通银行业务外，该银行还设有储蓄部，以高利率诱使穷人将储蓄存入该行。这些储蓄被银行用于资助其他业务。陆锡侯的其他投资包括“大世界”游乐场、华懋饭店（Hotel Plaza）、汤山浴室、 auditorium（原文如此，指某礼堂或影院）、国际赛马会等。由于国际赛马会被发现是赌博场所，当局拒绝颁发执照。陆从国外购买了150匹马，每匹成本1,000美元，并从国外聘请了一批骑师。陆花费巨资将这些马运至上海，自抵达以来，饲养这些马每天的费用约为1,000两白银。国际赛马会的开业已停滞三个月，维持该俱乐部的损失必定数额巨大。所有用于支付费用的资金均由中国工业银行垫付。

发现银行资源即将耗尽后，陆锡侯与已潜逃的银行经理秦抱元（Zing Bao Yuan）以及新华贸易公司和大生昌杂货号经理、杭州人孙希仁（Sun Shi Zung）共谋，寻找现金以维持国际赛马会的运营。

在银行关门前几天，孙希仁以新华贸易公司和大生昌杂货号的名义，从各家公司购买大量商品，并用开具自中国工业银行的支票支付货款。通过低价处置 thus obtained（原文如此，指以此方式获得的）货物，他们获得了现金以满足需求。
